jobs.title: Head of Brand (Relocation to Milan)
jobs.description:
Please note that this opportunity requires relocation to our Milan office.

About us

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.

Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.

Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be doing

As our Head of Brand, you'll own the creative and brand strategy end-to-end, bridging the gap between high-level storytelling and measurable business impact, ensuring our mission resonates across every touchpoint.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Creative Production - Owning the production of creative assets, ensuring every output meets a consistently high bar of quality, craft, and brand consistency.

  • Brand Activation - Driving both ATL (TV, radio, OOH, print) and BTL/untraditional activations, bringing the brand to life in bold and memorable ways.

  • Social Media & Community - Steering our presence across existing Social media channels and new ones, while building an influencer strategy that extends our reach and relevance.

  • Brand Strategy & Insights - Shaping and safeguarding brand identity, and grounding decisions in research and listening, including surveys with both customers and non-customers.

  • Leadership & Team Rituals - Building and mentoring the team behind these pillars, establishing clear creative rituals (design reviews, sprints, feedback loops) and tools to ensure efficient, high-quality output.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration - Partnering closely with Growth and Product teams to align brand initiatives with acquisition goals, retention targets, and product launches.

  • Performance-Driven Branding - Defining and tracking KPIs for brand awareness and consideration, ensuring that even the most "creative" projects are data-informed and contribute to Satispay's overarching OKRs.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

Who we're looking for

You'll take on one of the hardest challenges at our scale: defining Satispay's identity globally while ensuring our brand initiatives directly align with acquisition and retention goals — and building the creative team and rituals that stay ahead of it as we grow. We're not looking for a caretaker of an existing setup. We're looking for someone who has built or transformed a function, made hard calls under pressure, and can say "here's the decision, here's why, here's what happened."

  • 10+ years of experience - Proven track record in brand management or creative direction, ideally within fast-growing tech companies or top-tier creative agencies.

  • Strong Technical & Visual Culture - Deep understanding of design systems, rebranding processes, and multi-channel campaign production (from social media to TV/OOH).

  • A "Hands-on" Leader - You love to lead by example. You're not just a "manager of resources" but someone who can get into the details of a layout or a script to ensure excellence.

  • Data-Informed Mindset - Ability to translate brand concepts into business objectives, utilizing KPIs and OKRs to measure impact and iterate quickly.

  • Exceptional Communicator - Fluent in English, with the ability to simplify complex brand visions for internal stakeholders and external audiences alike.

We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.

Why this is your place

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impact are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

  • Own outcomes that reach millions. Lead functions where the results show up directly in the experience of 6.5M+ people and the businesses they pay every day.

  • Operate in high-growth. You'll make high-stakes calls without waiting for perfect information, in an environment that changes fast as we launch and scale new products.

  • Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.

  • Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

  • ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.

  • 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.

  • ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.

  • 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.

*We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.

Initial salary: Starting from €65,000 gross per annum

This baseline is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role's core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent. The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value.

Equal opportunity employer
At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin.
Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!

Learn more about us

jobs.title: Head of Program Management (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Munich Electrification

Munich Electrification is an innovative company founded with the aim of accelerating the transition to electric and connected mobility. We develop innovative electronic control units for electric vehicles and stationary storage systems for our global customers. Our international team is composed of highly motivated and exceptional engineers. As a small and specialized team we are well-aware of the importance of each individual colleague and support and promote each employee according to their abilities and needs. Our office with adjacent prototype and testing lab is located in the heart of Munich at the Heimeranplatz.

This is what we stand for:

- Technological Leadership: We challenge norms, innovate quickly, and anticipate future needs. We take smart risks and learn from outcomes to stay ahead.

- Sustainability: We actively drive change for a sustainable future, aware of our impact and inspiring others to build a better world.

- Team Culture: We believe work should be enjoyable, fostering a spirit of inspiration, celebration, and teamwork across the globe.

- Entrepreneurial Spirit: We embrace change, think big, and push limits with passion.

About the Role

As the Head of Program Management, you will own the execution of our project portfolio from first concept to series production across Automotive, Commercial Vehicle, and Industrial BESS. That means leading teams of Project Leads, Product Owners, and Field Application Engineers, and reporting directly to the Chief Customer Officer. You are an entrepreneurial leader who thrives on turning complex development roadmaps into tangible, high-quality products while balancing the unique demands of both vehicle-level and grid-scale energy storage safety and performance.

Your Future Tasks at a glance

  • Operational Excellence: Oversee the end-to-end execution of all projects, ensuring they meet milestones, budget constraints, and resource allocations. Identify cross-project synergies and manage dependencies to mitigate systemic risks.

  • Team Mentorship: Lead Team Leads and senior contributors to foster professional and technical growth.

  • Strategic Staffing: Optimize organizational structure and resource allocation across programs to balance capacity, driving throughput and profitability.

  • Department Alignment: Act as the primary interface for C-level management, aligning departmental goals with the overall company strategy and reporting on KPIs.

  • Governance & Process Design: Define and continuously optimize department processes and interfaces to other departments (Engineering, Operations, Sales, and Quality).

  • Conflict & Escalation Management: Serve as the ultimate internal escalation point for critical project roadblocks, and make the call.

  • Commercial & Technical Stewardship: Ensure that both commercial governance (contracts, deliveries) and technical maturity (e.g. V-cycle, ASPICE) stay on track across all programs.

Who you are and what you have

  • Experience: 8+ years of leadership in Program or Project Management, specifically in automotive, battery, or power electronics. You have successfully led a "team of teams."

  • Education: A university degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field that combines technical understanding with commercial acumen.

  • The "Advocacy" Trait: You are comfortable pushing back. When cross-functional goals conflict, you can mediate and make firm decisions, acting as a buffer for your team rather than just escalating or deferring.

  • Leadership Skills: Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams (interacting with HW, SW, Systems, Operations) and manage leaders (Team Leads).

  • Communication: Exceptional presentation and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust with international Tier-1 or OEM customers and navigate C-level stakeholders.

What We Offer

  • Impact: A key leadership role (~30 direct or indirect reports) with the autonomy to shape the future of our program management organization.

  • Culture: A flat hierarchy that values direct, honest communication and fast decision-making over process for process’s sake.

  • Growth: Be at the forefront of the green energy transition, in a high-tech, international, fast-growing company.

  • Flexibility: Modern working conditions with a focus on results.

Our Offer & Benefits

The chance to be part of a highly innovative, agile, and unique team with prestigious customers in the automotive and battery storage sector. You will gain a deeper knowledge around connected & electric vehicle batteries, battery management and electronics development and strive in an exciting work environment

Benefits (Full-time Employees):

- Trust-based working hours and hybrid work

- Adequate and competitive compensation

- Pension Plan/Bonus

- Free access to the fitness center right next to us or subsidized EGYM Wellpass

- Free snacks, coffee, drinks and lunch (freshly cooked by our chef) every day

- Public transport ticket

- Bike-Leasing via Business Bike

- Experience various inspiring and fun team events

- ME-branded clothing

- Option to "work from anywhere" (6 weeks/year)

- Team Culture: We believe work should be enjoyable, fostering a spirit of inspiration, celebration, and teamwork across the globe.

- Entrepreneurial Spirit: We embrace change, think big, and push limits with passion.

About the role

The Microfactory serves as our advanced internal sample shop, bridging the gap between early product design and global mass production. In this role, your main focus will be supporting day-to-day sample shop operations, executing physical engineering improvement projects, and helping build early product variants. Additionally, you will participate in special projects to support the gradual introduction of Manufacturing 4.0 / Industry 4.0 initiatives (such as smart tools and digital data capture) under the guidance of senior engineers.

Your future tasks at a glance

  • Sample Shop Support & Build Execution: Assist the engineering team in preparing, physically assembling, and tracking early-stage prototypes, alpha/beta samples, and variant builds within the microfactory.

  • Process Improvement Projects: Proactively identify baseline process bottlenecks or layout inefficiencies on the floor. Bring creative ideas to the team and collaborate directly with engineers to physically implement and execute these workplace improvements.

  • Equipment & Assembly Upgrades: Assist in installing, maintaining, and upgrading physical assembly fixtures, mechanical workbenches, and hardware components inside the microfactory.

  • Manufacturing 4.0 & Traceability Support: Support secondary engineering projects focused on smart factory tool configuration, component tracking integration (e.g., hardware scanning, torque logging), and digital work instructions.

  • Lessons Learned & Documentation: Help capture data, parameter records, and assembly issues encountered during sample builds to compile clear, insightful documentation for our external production partners.

What you bring with you

  • Current Studies: Enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechatronics, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Hands-On Mindset: Highly motivated by hands-on engineering tasks. You love moving between a technical workspace and a physical assembly bench to build things and tackle technical challenges.

  • Proactive Approach: A self-starter attitude with the ability to look at processes on the shop floor, spot layout or assembly inefficiencies, and pitch action plans.

  • Technical Basics: Familiarity with core Lean principles, cycle times, takt times, and how process constraints impact overall production flow. Exposure to or interest in smart factory elements is beneficial.

  • Communication: Collaborative team player with solid written and verbal communication habits in English.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The AI Customer Success function is being built from the ground up, and this role will help define it internationally. As the first Customer Success Manager in this area, you will own the end-to-end post-sale experience for a portfolio of customers that includes some of the world’s most sophisticated cyber threat intelligence teams and investigators, national security agencies, and financial crime teams. Your mandate is not just to manage accounts—you will help establish the playbook, define what success looks like, and drive a product-led growth motion that turns new customers into long-term, expanding partners.

The impact you will have:

  • Build and ship a v1 onboarding playbook within the first 30 days—a practical, working version built from early customer engagements that can be iterated as you learn what drives adoption across international customer segments.

  • Use AI to build production CS workflows that pull from ChurnZero, Salesforce, Gong, and product usage telemetry to auto-generate account health summaries and QBR drafts—compressing hours of reporting preparation into minutes so you can spend your time on the work that actually requires human judgment.

  • Define and track adoption benchmarks across the portfolio—hands-on-keyboard usage, consumption rates, and account-specific success metrics—and surface at-risk accounts before renewal decisions are made.

  • Identify and scope the highest-impact PLG play within 60 days by working backwards from expansion targets, focusing on the one or two use cases most likely to drive consumption across the customer base.

  • Run executive business reviews and QBRs with senior stakeholders at government agencies and financial institutions internationally—building the trust and credibility that turns TRM from a vendor into a mission-critical partner.

  • Partner with ADs on expansion plays, co-own NRR targets, and build the structured path to proving value for every customer with an expiring or at-risk contract.

  • Close the feedback loop between customers and Product—synthesize adoption blockers, feature gaps, and new use-case opportunities into prioritized, actionable input that informs the roadmap.

  • Design the CS infrastructure and tooling stack that scales as the product grows—you are building the foundation the next CSM hire will inherit.

What we're looking for:

  • Background in cyber or cyber threat intelligence, intelligence agencies, financial crime investigations, or regulatory and compliance environments.

  • 5+ years as an onboarding engineer, customer success manager, deployment strategist, or in another post-sale role with proven ownership of NRR, GRR, and expansion metrics—you have the track record, not just the title.

  • Domain credibility in cyber, national security, or financial crime—you can walk into a room of investigators and earn their trust in the first meeting, not the fifth.

  • Demonstrated zero-to-one builder experience—you have built a CS function, onboarding playbook, or PLG motion from scratch and can point to the specific outcomes it drove.

  • Production AI fluency—you have built real, repeatable AI workflows, not just experiments, that synthesize data from multiple sources into outputs that run consistently and deliver measurable results. You can show the workflow, explain the data logic, and articulate where human judgment stays in the loop.

  • A high level of independence—you set your own agenda, operate without needing constant direction, and ship v1 before you have all the answers.

  • Strong executive presence—you can run a QBR with a senior government stakeholder or financial institution executive and command the room through substance, not just polish.

  • Experience supporting international customers, with the ability to navigate regional, cultural, and time-zone differences.

About the Team:

  • This team focuses on TRM’s AI-driven Intel platform, supporting investigators and cyber teams working on complex cases involving cyber threats.

  • This is the first Customer Success hire dedicated to international customers—you will help build the function from the ground up, with high autonomy, direct access to leadership, and meaningful influence on how TRM approaches customer success globally.

  • The broader TRM CS organization operates distributed, not distant—async-first communication through Slack, strong documentation, and intentional synchronous time for key decisions.

  • You will work directly with the Head of Customer Success and Patrick South, CRO, with close day-to-day collaboration with international Sales teams and Product.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • As a globally distributed team, members work across multiple time zones. This role will primarily align its working hours and customer coverage with international markets, with flexibility to collaborate across regions when needed.

  • Our Customer Success team is fully remote, thriving on asynchronous communication and collaboration through Slack channels and detailed documentation. We hold weekly customer syncs, biweekly health syncs, join our associated POD calls, and regularly engage with customers across international markets. As experts in our craft, we focus on providing support, driving value, and building meaningful relationships with our customers as trusted advisors. We are on the front lines of TRM, ensuring our customers get the most out of the product and bringing valuable insights back to the team.

  • The team moves fast and iterates—v1 ships before it is perfect, and feedback is expected to be direct and specific.

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • End-to-End Ownership: While there is no formal hourly rotation, you will be the primary lead for your area and responsible for customer success across international markets. This requires a high degree of agency and a commitment to seeing mission-critical tasks through to resolution, including the flexibility to handle urgent needs outside of standard hours or on weekends when they arise.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within 30 days of joining, you ship a working v1 onboarding playbook built from your first 2–3 accounts—not a slide deck, but a live document with measurable adoption benchmarks that the account team is already using to set customer expectations.

  • Within 6 weeks, you share a draft success-metrics framework at 50% complete with the account team and key customers to validate direction—getting real signal on what drives credit consumption before investing further in building out the full playbook.

  • Within 60 days, you identify and scope the highest-impact PLG play by working backwards from expansion targets—presenting a concrete recommendation to leadership on which use case to prioritize and why, grounded in actual account data from international customers.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure you’re considered.

What to Expect From Our Interview Process

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while giving you the opportunity to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, AI skills assessment, and Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Dive deeper into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: Typically 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Typically 3–5 interviews to go deeper on your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: We’ll speak with former colleagues who can provide perspective on your work and impact.

  • Offer: If it’s a mutual fit, your recruiter will walk you through your offer and answer your questions.

  • Welcome to TRM: Once you sign, we’ll get you ready for your first day and onboarding.

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

Learn more about interviewing at TRM

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly as we experiment and iterate

  • Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires comfort navigating ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. Learn more about Interviewing at TRM

 

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore. Learn more about building tools for defenders.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

What you'll own as our Senior AI Product Designer

  • You'll own end-to-end design for one of our core product areas, on a platform where AI is the foundation of the product, not a bolt-on feature. Your mission is to bring consumer-grade craft to a B2B healthcare product used by clinicians and hospital administrators under real time pressure, and to help invent the design patterns for AI-native surfaces that don't exist anywhere else yet.

  • You design the AI-native surfaces our platform is built around, including multi-modal interfaces, agent state, uncertainty, and human-in-the-loop controls, inventing the patterns as you go rather than adapting existing ones.

  • You own end-to-end design for a product area – Discharge Core, Voice Desktop, Extract & Docs, Patient Overview, or Agent – taking work from a messy problem statement through to what ships in production.

  • You contribute to our design system, building the components and AI-specific conventions that other designers and teams build on.

  • You partner closely with product and engineering, shaping technical and product direction rather than being handed a spec to execute against.

    You work with other designers across the organisation, bringing your input and influence beyond your own product area rather than staying inside a single team's boundary.

  • You hold a high craft bar in critique, lifting the standard of what the wider design team ships.

You help hold coherence across our AI Suite (Voice, Docs, Extract, Agent) and Discharge Core, so a fast-growing multi-product platform still feels like one product to the people using it.

How we design:

  • We're AI-native. We use AI tools daily in our own process, not just in what we design, and we want strong, opinionated views on how to wield them well.

  • Consumer-grade craft is the bar, even in B2B. Our users are clinicians and hospital administrators.

  • Human-in-the-loop by default. This is healthcare: AI proposes, people stay in control, and we design the approval and verification moments that make that real, not just a confidence score bolted on.

  • We ship in production, not just in Figma. Craft is judged by what clinicians actually use, so we stay close to what ships.

What to expect as our Senior AI Product Designer (m/w/d):

  • Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

jobs.title: Medical Director (m/w/x)
jobs.description:
Role

Als Medical Director verantwortest du den medizinischen Themenkatalog einer der größten CME-Lernplattformen Deutschlands. Was wir zeigen, erreicht unzählige Ärzt:innen – deine inhaltlichen Entscheidungen haben unmittelbaren Einfluss darauf, welches medizinische Wissen in Deutschland ankommt.

Du führst unser siebenköpfiges Medical Team, hältst den Kontakt zu Chefärzt:innen und Meinungsbildner:innen, entwickelst neue Fortbildungsformate mit und baust die Prozesse, mit denen wir vom Startup zum Scale-up werden. Die Rolle ist bewusst breit: strategisch in der Katalog- und Formatentwicklung, operativ im Tagesgeschäft, und immer mit der ärztlichen Perspektive als Maßstab.


Your tasks

  • Verantwortung für den Themenkatalog: Du steuerst, welche medizinischen Themen wir abdecken – fachübergreifend, evidenzbasiert und mit einem klaren Blick für Versorgungsrelevanz und Lücken im Markt.

  • Referenten-Netzwerk: Du bist tagtäglich im Austausch mit Chefärzt:innen und KOLs, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und gewinnst daraus kontinuierlich neue Fortbildungsideen.

  • Team-Leadership: Du führst und entwickelst unser Medical Team – zwei Vollzeitkolleg:innen und fünf Studierende. Die Medical Editors arbeiten inhaltlich und stimmen Projekte mit Sponsoren und Referent:innen ab; die Medical Students übernehmen Quality Control, erstellen Kursbeschreibungen und entwickeln neue Themenideen.

  • Formatentwicklung: Wir produzieren Videos, Panel-Diskussionen und E-Learnings – Form und Inhalt greifen ineinander. Bei neuen Formaten wie Kurzvideos oder der Gamification des Lernerlebnisses ist dein medizinischer Input und die ärztliche Perspektive der entscheidende Faktor.

  • Projekt- und Themensteuerung: Du managst die Themenideen laufender Projekte und stimmst dich eng mit Referent:innen ab, damit Projektanforderungen inhaltlich sauber umgesetzt werden.

  • Qualitätssicherung & Compliance: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Fortbildungen den CME-Standards entsprechen, evidenzbasiert sind und die regulatorischen Anforderungen erfüllen.

  • Prozessverbesserung & Automatisierung: Auf unserem Weg zum Scale-up stehen Automatisierung und schlanke Prozesse im Mittelpunkt. Du streamlinest Workflows und Dokumentationstools im Team und teamübergreifend – als Director bist du dabei die Schlüsselrolle für funktionierende Cross-Department-Zusammenarbeit.


Your profile

  • Hintergrund: Abgeschlossenes Studium der Medizin.

  • Berufserfahrung: Idealerweise 5+ Jahre Berufserfahrung, gern klinisch, in der Industrie oder in der digitalen Gesundheitsbranche.

  • Führungserfahrung: Erste Erfahrung als Team Lead ist ein klarer Vorteil – entscheidend ist, dass du Menschen entwickeln und Prioritäten setzen kannst.

  • Anpack-Mindset: Wir skalieren. Du regelst Dinge selbst, statt sie nur zu delegieren, und scheust dich nicht davor, auch operativ mit reinzugehen.

  • Begeisterung für Prozesse: Du hast Freude an Projektmanagement, Strukturaufbau und medizinischem Content bzw. medizinischer Lehre – diese Kombination ist der Kern der Rolle.

  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung in einem Startup sowie in der medizinischen Lehre.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber führenden Mediziner:innen und Industriepartnern, professioneller Kommunikationsstil mündlich und schriftlich.

  • Sprachen: Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau und fließendes Englisch sind Voraussetzung.


Why us?

  • Echter Impact: Die Themen, die du verantwortest, erreichen über zig tausende Ärzt:innen. Durch die Verbreitung des neuesten medizinischen Wissens hast du direkten Einfluss auf die Versorgungsqualität in Deutschland.

  • Mitgestaltung: Du prägst neue Fortbildungsformate und den medizinischen Qualitätsanspruch der Plattform von Grund auf mit.

  • Wachstum & Perspektive: Wir wachsen schnell – entsprechend gibt es echte Aufstiegs- und Gestaltungschancen, die mit dem Unternehmen mitwachsen.

  • Ownership: Kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und die Freiheit, eigene Ideen umzusetzen.

  • Team: Ein junges, motiviertes und wirklich gutes Team in Prenzlauer Berg. Teamevents, Ausflüge sowie Bier und Wein im Kühlschrank gehören dazu.

  • Benefits: Attraktives Gehaltspaket inkl. Aktienpaket (VSOP) sowie ein Urban Sports Club Abo.

jobs.title: Vil du utvikle plattformen som knytter politiets digitale tjenester til omverdenen?
jobs.description:
Om stillingen

Kommunikasjonsplattformen er en del av grunnmuren for politiets digitale tjenester. Den skal sørge for at tjenester er tilgjengelige for de rette brukerne, samtidig som trafikken styres, kontrolleres og beskyttes. Vi ser etter deg som motiveres av denne kompleksiteten. Du forstår hvordan nettverk, sikkerhet, plattform og applikasjoner virker sammen, og vet hva som kreves for å utvikle løsninger som skal være stabile og sikre over tid. Hos oss får du arbeide med en stor hybrid infrastruktur, høye krav til tilgjengelighet og sikkerhet og tekniske avhengigheter som går på tvers av egne datasentre og sky.

Som Platform Engineer blir du en del av teamet som utvikler, forvalter og drifter politiets kommunikasjonsplattform. Teamet har ansvar for sikker ekstern tilgang til og publisering av tjenester og applikasjoner. En viktig del av oppgaven er å gjøre plattformen mer standardisert, automatisert og selvbetjent, slik at utviklingsteam kan levere raskere uten at det går på bekostning av sikkerhet eller kontroll. 

Du får både fordype deg i krevende tekniske problemstillinger og påvirke hvordan plattformen skal utvikles videre. Dette er en rolle for deg som liker å forstå hele trafikkflyten, finne årsaken når sammensatte løsninger ikke fungerer som forventet, og omsette driftserfaring til varige forbedringer og kode.

Du blir en del av Seksjon for Infrastruktur, et fagmiljø på rundt 90 medarbeidere som jobber i tverrfaglige team med felles ansvar, kunnskapsdeling og kontinuerlig forbedring. Selv om vi primært rekrutterer til Team Kommunikasjonsplattform, er strukturen fleksibel, og endringer i team eller arbeidsoppgaver kan skje etter hvert som behovene endrer seg.

I Politiets IT-enhet er vi over 850 ansatte. Vi skaper verdi for innbyggerne, samarbeidspartnere og kollegaer i politiet. Som en del av politiets viktige samfunnsoppdrag, skal vi forebygge og bekjempe kriminalitet, skape trygghet og ivareta rettssikkerheten. Vi er på jobb for et trygt Norge.


Arbeidsoppgaver

Oppgavene vil variere med behovene i teamet og utviklingen av plattformen. Typiske oppgaver er å:

  • utvikle, automatisere og drifte plattformtjenester for sikker ekstern tilgang og publisering
  • utvikle og forvalte løsninger for trafikkstyring, lastbalansering, reverse proxy og ekstern DNS i egne datasentre og Azure
  • beskrive og forvalte infrastruktur og konfigurasjon som kode ved hjelp av blant annet Terraform, Python og Crossplane
  • utvikle standardiserte og gjenbrukbare løsninger som gjør det enklere for andre team å publisere tjenester sikkert
  • feilsøke sammensatte problemer, analysere hendelser og gjennomføre varige forbedringer på tvers av nettverk, plattform og applikasjon
  • etablere god overvåking og dokumentasjon, dele kunnskap og rådgi team som bruker plattformtjenestene

Arbeidsstedet ditt blir på Majorstuen. 


Kvalifikasjoner
  • Relevant høyere utdanning innen IT på minimum bachelor-nivå. Lang og relevant erfaring kan kompensere for manglende formell utdanning
  • Minimum tre års relevant erfaring med utvikling, automatisering eller drift av nettverks-, kommunikasjons- eller applikasjonsplattformer
  • Praktisk erfaring med Nginx-baserte (eller tilsvarende) løsninger i både lokale miljøer og sky, herunder lastbalansering og reverse proxy
  • Erfaring med infrastruktur som kode og automatisering ved hjelp av Terraform, Python, Crossplane eller tilsvarende
  • God forståelse av Linux, nettverk og webteknologier, og erfaring med systematisk feilsøking på tvers av plattform og applikasjon
  • Kunnskap om og erfaring med protokoller som TCP, TLS og HTTP, inkludert feilsøking av disse
  • God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk. Arbeidsspråket vårt er norsk

For å bli vurdert som søker til stillingen, må du oppfylle alle kravene over.

Du må ha plettfri vandel og være skikket for tjeneste i politiet. Ved å søke på stillingen samtykker du til at det gjøres en skikkethetsvurdering av deg. Vurdering av skikket- og egnethet vil bli vektlagt. Politiattest (uttømmende og utvidet) må innhentes ved ev. ansettelse jfr. politiloven § 18 og politiregisterloven § 41. Les mer på politiet.no/jobbipit.

Stillingen forutsetter sikkerhetsklarering på nivå HEMMELIG og autorisasjon. Du må kunne sikkerhetsklareres på nivå HEMMELIG og autoriseres før du begynner i jobben. Les mer her: https://nsm.no/fagomrader/personellsikkerhet/sikkerhetsklarering/slik-blir-dusikkerhetsklarert/

I tillegg er det ønskelig om du har erfaring med noe av dette:

  • Azure, Kubernetes og utvikling eller drift av skybaserte plattformtjenester
  • NetScaler, DNS, TLS (sertifikathåndtering) og ACME
  • Git, CI/CD og automatiserte prosesser for bygging, testing og utrulling
  • PostgreSQL, observability eller drift av plattformtjenester med høye krav til sikkerhet og tilgjengelighet

Listen beskriver bredden i fagområdet, ikke en forventning om at du kan alt. Har du solid erfaring fra deler av fagområdet, men mindre erfaring med enkelte av teknologiene vi bruker? Da ønsker vi likevel å høre fra deg. Du får mulighet til å bygge videre på det du kan, sammen med kollegaer som deler kunnskap.


Personlige egenskaper

Vi tror du vil ha det fint hos oss om du:

  • jobber analytisk og systematisk, og søker etter rotårsaken når komplekse løsninger ikke fungerer som forventet
  • tar ansvar for helheten, følger opp det du starter og sier tydelig fra om risiko og avhengigheter
  • samarbeider godt, deler kunnskap og gjør tekniske problemstillinger forståelige for andre

Vi legger vekt på personlige egenskaper i rekrutteringen av vår nye platform engineer.

Som medarbeider i politiet har du høy etisk bevissthet, du kjennetegnes av å være modig og helhetsorientert, du viser respekt og er tett på. Du kan lese mer om våre etiske retningslinjer og medarbeiderplattform her.


Dette kan vi tilby om du velger oss
  • Stillingen lønnes som seniorrådgiver (stillingskode 1346) med årslønn kr. 750 000-1 000 000. For særlig kvalifiserte søkere kan høyere lønn vurderes.
  • Medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse, med blant annet gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Les mer på spk.no. 
  • Gode arbeidsbetingelser (fast avsatt tid til kompetanseheving, sommer- og vintertid, fleksibel arbeidstid, mulighet for hjemmekontor, mulighet for trening i arbeidstiden).
  • Les mer om alle godene ved å jobbe i Politiets IT-enhet og bli bedre kjent med oss på politiet.no/jobbipit.

Mangfold i politiet

Vi tror at mangfold bidrar til bedre oppgaveløsning, og søker derfor medarbeidere med ulik bakgrunn, erfaring, perspektiv og kompetanse. Dersom du har behov for tilrettelegging i rekrutteringsprosessen eller arbeidshverdagen, vil vi gjøre vårt beste for å gi deg det du trenger.

Har du funksjonsnedsettelse, innvandrerbakgrunn eller hull i CV-en, kan du krysse av for dette i søknaden. Er du kvalifisert for stillingen, vil du bli vurdert for positiv særbehandling. Det betyr at minst én søker fra hver av disse gruppene blir innkalt til intervju.

Les mer om positiv særbehandling når du søker jobb i staten på arbeidsgiver.dfo.no.

Opplysningene du gir brukes til å utarbeide anonymisert statistikk som alle statlige virksomheter rapporterer i sine årsrapporter.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uUTjHmSB_WcSlik søker du

Du søker ved å fylle ut CV i Jobbnorges CV-skjema og skrive en kort søknad. I tillegg må du legge ved relevante vitnemål og attester. Kvalifiserte kandidater vil bli kalt inn til intervju. 

Sett deg raskt inn i hva som skjer når du søker jobb hos oss. Rekrutteringsprosessen finner du på politiet.no/jobbipit.

I søknadsportalen Jobbnorge kan du krysse av for å ikke komme på den offentlige søkerlisten. Vi vil ta kontakt med deg hvis vi ikke godkjenner ønsket ditt. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Et kriminalitetsbilde i endring, den sikkerhetspolitiske situasjonen og den raske digitaliseringen gjør at politiet må rigge seg bedre. Vi må endre oss for å stå i kontinuering utvikling og for å opprettholde et trygt Norge. 

I fremtiden må politiet levere tjenester på andre måter, derfor må vi tenke nytt om hvordan fag og teknologi virker sammen. Politiets IT-enhet har det helhetlige ansvaret for teknologiutviklingen i politiet.

Produktene vi lager skal gi verdi for innbyggerne, samarbeidspartnere og kollegaene våre i politiet. Vi lærer underveis, videreutvikler og måler at vi er på rett vei. Verdien skaper vi skritt for skritt. 

Vi jobber i tverrfaglige team og tett med brukerne våre. Sammen skaper vi et mer digitalt og tilgjengelig politi. 

Vi jobber for å se hverandres perspektiver og dele kunnskap med hverandre. Ikke minst eier vi helheten sammen.

Les mer om hvordan vi jobber på politiet.no/jobbipit.

Rattaché(e) à la Direction et en relation avec les équipes, vos missions sont les suivantes :

1. Gestion Administration du personnel / RH

- Création et mise à jour des dossiers du personnel
- Gestion des absences, arrêts maladie et accidents du travail
- Rédaction des contrats de travail et documents administratifs
- Réalisation des DPAE et des AED
- Établissement des certificats de travail
- Gestion des adhésions à la complémentaire santé obligatoire
- Suivi des visites médicales et relations avec la médecine du travail
- Suivi administratif des salariés et des contrats CDD
- Retranscription et suivi des plannings dans OCTIME
- Gestion des vacataires via la plate-forme Hublo

2. Gestion administrative et logistique

- Gestion de l'accueil de certains rendez-vous de la Directrice
- Organisation et préparation des réunions
- Établissement et diffusion des invitations, mailings et communications
- Participation aux réunions du Conseil de la Vie Sociale et proposition du compte-rendu à la directrice, suivi de sa validation et de sa diffusion
- Prise de notes et rédaction de comptes rendus et relevés de décisions de certaines réunions
- Classement et archivage des documents
- Gestion de la correspondance et des documents administratifs
- Assurer la continuité des commandes en l'absence de l'agent d'accueil/économat : linge, repas et fournitures diverses.  Profil recherché :
- Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme de niveau Bac+2 en secrétariat, type BTS Support à l'Action Managériale ou équivalent.
- Vous maîtrisez la législation sociale, la gestion des contrats de travail et l'utilisation d'un logiciel de paie.
- Vous disposez idéalement de connaissances sur la convention collective CCN 51, ce qui constituerait un atout majeur pour le poste.
- Vous maîtrisez parfaitement les outils bureautiques et rédigez vos écrits avec une orthographe irréprochable.
- Vous placez la bienveillance et l'écoute au coeur de vos échanges, avec le souhait fort de vous investir auprès des personnes accompagnées.
- Vous faites preuve d'une organisation exemplaire, d'une grande rigueur et d'une forte capacité d'adaptation face aux priorités.
- Vous agissez avec une discrétion absolue, une totale loyauté et un engagement quotidien aux côtés de la direction.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

- Vous intégrez la structure via un CDD de 3 mois, avec des perspectives de renouvellement pour 2027.

jobs.title: Svetsansvarig
jobs.description:
Svetsansvarig (IWS) till Naverviken Logistic AB

Ort: Karlskoga/Degerfors

Omfattning: Heltid, tillsvidareanställning

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Vill du ta helhetsansvar för svetsverksamheten i ett företag som växer? Naverviken Logistic AB söker nu en erfaren och engagerad svetsansvarig med IWS-utbildning som vill vara med och säkra kvaliteten i allt vi tillverkar.

Om företaget

Naverviken grundades 2003 och har sedan dess etablerat sig som en stark aktör inom legotillverkning avseende plåtbearbetning, så som svetsning, laserskärning, ytbehandling, kantpressning och rörbockning. Bolaget har en bred kundportfölj och samarbetar med ledande företag inom försvar-, gruv- och kärnkraftsindustrin. Bolaget växer givet hög efterfrågan på komplexa konstruktioner med höga kvalitetskrav. Naverviken är en del av industrikoncernen Matenco Group sedan 2022.

Om rollen

Som svetsansvarig blir du vår nyckelperson för allt som rör svetsning. Du ansvarar för att arbetet utförs enligt gällande standarder och kundkrav, och du är ett stöd för både svetsare, produktion och ledning. Rollen kombinerar tekniskt ansvar med praktiskt arbete nära verksamheten.

Arbetsuppgifter

·      Upprätthålla och utveckla vårt kvalitetssystem för svetsning enligt SS-EN ISO 3834 och/eller SS-EN 1090

·      Ta fram, granska och godkänna svetsdatablad (WPS) och procedurprövningar (WPQR)

·      Planera och övervaka svetsarprövningar samt hålla svetsarnas certifikat aktuella

·      Utföra och samordna kontroll och provning, t.ex. visuell kontroll och oförstörande provning (OFP)

·      Hantera avvikelser, spårbarhet och dokumentation mot kunder och certifieringsorgan

·      Stötta och utbilda kollegor i svetsteknik och arbetsmiljö

Vi söker dig som

·      Har genomgått IWS-utbildning (International Welding Specialist) med godkänt diplom

·      Har flera års erfarenhet av svetsning i industriell miljö

·      Har erfarenhet av arbete enligt ISO 3834, EN 1090, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001

·      Är van att arbeta med WPS, WPQR och svetsarcertifikat

·      Är noggrann, strukturerad och trygg i att fatta beslut

·      Kommunicerar väl på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

Våra kärnvärden

Vår verksamhet vilar på fyra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang, delaktighet och kamratskap. De genomsyrar hur vi arbetar och bemöter varandra i vardagen, och vi förväntar oss att alla kollegor lever upp till dem.

Vi erbjuder

·      En självständig nyckelroll med stort inflytande över hur vi arbetar

·      Tillsvidareanställning på heltid med konkurrenskraftig lön

·      Tjänstepension och friskvårdsbidrag

·      Ett engagerat team och korta beslutsvägar

Arbetstider

·      måndag – torsdag 06:45-16:00

·      fredag 06:45 -13:00

Sista ansökningsdag

Ansök gärna så snart som möjligt, dock senast 23 oktober

Kontakt  

Vid frågor kan du kontakta Jasmina Jakupovic;

jasmina.jakupovic@naverviken.se,

jobs.title: Personlig assistent till kvinna i Horred, kväll och helg
jobs.description:
Vi söker personlig assistent med vårderfarenhet till en av Pater Assistans brukare i Horred. Timvikarie kväll och helg.

Brukaren är en 33-årig kvinna i Horred som söker assistenter dygnet runt.

"Jag söker dig som är glad, positiv och initiativtagande. Du är fysiskt och psykiskt stark och kan hantera stressiga situationer. Jag sitter i rullstol och har krampanfall. Jag behöver hjälp och stöttning i vardagen. Du ska vilja gå på promenader, laga mat och hitta på saker som sätter guldkant på min vardag."

Tjänsten ligger i Horred. Tjänsten kan variera i omfattning, så berätta hur du vill arbeta. Brukaren har behov av assistans hela dygnet. Du behöver kunna arbeta på kvällar och helger, främst. Schemat kommer vara varierat.

Du arbetar i en arbetsgrupp tillsammans med andra assistenter som alla utgör ett viktigt stöd för att skapa en fin tillvaro. På varje arbetspass är ni två personer hos brukaren.

Vi söker dig som är flexibel och positiv som person. Du behöver bo i Horred, eller om du bor utanför Horred behöver du kunna köra egen bil till jobbet. Det är viktigt med körkort och egen bil om du inte bor i Horred, eftersom kollektivtrafiken är begränsad till Horred.

Du kommer att få gå bredvid tillsammans med en annan personlig assistent innan du börjar.

Vi söker dig som har tidigare erfarenhet av liknande arbete, och personlig lämplighet är viktigast. Du är positiv, lyhörd och strukturerad. Arbetet som personlig assistent ställer krav på initiativförmåga och att du trivs med ensamarbete och är beredd att utföra för yrket sedvanliga uppgifter.

Det är viktigt att du har mycket goda kunskaper i det svenska språket. Har du delegeringsutbildning i Marks Kommun är det ett plus.

Intervjuer sker löpande – först med verksamhetsansvarig genom ett digitalt videomöte. Därefter träffar du brukaren och gruppledaren.

Skicka ditt CV och ett personligt brev till jobb@pater.se och berätta varför just du passar som personlig assistent och vad du har för erfarenhet av vård.

OBS: Skriv Horred i rubriken på ditt mail.

Ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret behöver visas upp vid anställning.

jobs.title: B2B-selger | Hjemmekontor i Bergen | Deltid 20–60 %
jobs.description:
Vil du bruke salgserfaringen din til å hjelpe virksomheter med å finne folkene de trenger? AllCare søker en telefonsterk B2B-selger i Bergen. Fra hjemmekontor følger du prioriterte leads fra første samtale til signert avtale.

Dette selger du

Du tilbyr rekrutteringstjenester til virksomheter med konkrete bemanningsbehov. Gjennom telefon og oppfølging avklarer du behovet, presenterer AllCares løsning og følger kunden frem til en beslutning. Du får bruke både evnen til å åpne dører og ferdighetene som skal til for å lande en avtale.

Dette får du hos oss

  • Prioriterte leads fra virksomheter med aktive rekrutteringsbehov.

  • Tydelige prisrammer og ferdige tilbudsmaler.

  • Veiledning og løpende sparring om kundedialog og oppfølging.

  • Hjemmekontor og avtalt stillingsomfang på 20--60 %.

Du får et konkret utgangspunkt for salgsarbeidet, samtidig som du selv tar ansvar for aktivitet, fremdrift og resultater. Arbeidet foregår på dagtid i ukedagene, når kundene er tilgjengelige. Oppstart og omfang avtales med deg.

Hvem passer rollen for?

Du er trygg på utgående telefonsamtaler, stiller gode spørsmål og følger opp systematisk. Du tåler avslag, holder avtaler og trives med å arbeide selvstendig. Erfaring fra B2B-salg, forsikring, telekom eller annet telefonbasert salg er relevant. Du trenger ikke erfaring fra rekruttering.

Stillingen innebærer ordinær ansettelse i AllCare Solutions AS, med innmelding i Aa-registeret og lønn gjennom selskapets ordinære lønnssystem. Det er ren provisjon uten fastlønn eller timelønn: 20 % av innbetalt ordinært salg og 30 % ved no cure no pay. Provisjonen beregnes av innbetalt salg ekskl. mva.

Søk med en kort søknad

Trykk <<Gå til søknad>> for å se hvordan rollen fungerer og lese lønnsmodellen før du søker. Fortell kort om salgserfaringen din, gjerne et konkret resultat, og hvor mye du ønsker å jobbe. Du trenger ikke skrive en tradisjonell søknad. Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

AllCare leverer rekruttering og bemanning innen helse og omsorg til private og offentlige virksomheter i hele Norge. Vi kombinerer målrettet kandidatsøk, grundig kvalifisering og tett oppfølging for å hjelpe kundene med å dekke kompetansebehov.

jobs.title: Chef de projet - Grands comptes cabinets comptables F/H
jobs.description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Tu aimes trouver du sens dans ton travail et travailler sur une solution qui pourrait aider des millions d'entrepreneur demain ? Tu t'épanouis dans un environnement sain, dont les bases sont la confiance et l'autonomie ?

Alors peut-être que Pennylane est fait pour toi !

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs et les cabinets d'expertise comptable à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Pourquoi ce rôle est il si important chez nous ?

Le pôle Grands Comptes de Pennylane a été créé en janvier 2022 pour accompagner les 150 plus grands cabinets comptables français dans leur transformation digitale. Depuis, il s'est imposé comme un levier stratégique de croissance : ce sont des milliers de collaborateurs et de clients finaux embarqués sur Pennylane via des déploiement initiaux ou des rachats de cabinets.

Le Chef de Projet est le pilier de cette relation. Il est le premier visage de Pennylane pour nos partenaires stratégiques, celui qui pose les fondations de la confiance et garantit l'excellence opérationnelle à chaque étape. Avec la croissance du nombre de cabinets à accompagner, nous renforçons notre équipe de 6 Chefs de Projet pour continuer à délivrer un niveau d'accompagnement de haut niveau, mais aussi pour contribuer l’évolution nos pratiques de méthodologies de gestion de projet.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En rejoignant l'équipe Key Account, tu prendras en charge un portefeuille de cabinets comptables Grands Comptes à chaque étape de leur relation avec Pennylane : de la réponse à l'appel d'offres jusqu'au déploiement complet de la solution.

Ton impact se mesure à plusieurs niveaux :

  • Pour les cabinets partenaires : tu es le garant d'une expérience de découverte et de déploiement fluide, professionnelle et rassurante, qui transforme des décisionnaires exigeants en ambassadeurs de Pennylane.

  • Pour Pennylane : tu contribues directement à l’acquisition et au déploiement de nos plus grands partenaires, des comptes à fort enjeu stratégique et commercial.

  • Pour l'équipe : tu contribues à faire évoluer nos process pour les rendre encore plus robustes.

MISSIONS

Pilotage de la phase pilote (3 à 6 mois)

  • Organiser et animer les phases de test sur un échantillon représentatif de collaborateurs et de clients finaux du cabinet.

  • Garantir une couverture exhaustive des fonctionnalités Pennylane, en t'appuyant sur les outils d'analyse et la méthodologie de l'équipe, tout en l'adaptant au contexte de chaque cabinet.

  • KPIs : Maîtrise niveau 1 du produit, de la méthodologie et des outils internes. Prise en charge accompagnée de 1-2 comptes à M+3

Orchestration du déploiement (6 à 9 mois)

  • Construire et piloter le planning de déploiement en co-construction avec les intervenants Pennylane et les équipes projet des cabinets.

  • Coordonner les équipes internes Pennylane mobilisées sur le compte : commercial, migration, interopérabilité, consultant fonctionnel, formateurs, produit.

  • KPIs : Autonomie complète sur la gestion d'un portefeuille de comptes à M+8.

Relation et conseil client

  • Être l'interlocuteur de référence des décisionnaires des cabinets (associés, directeurs transformation, directeurs de production comptable).

  • Comprendre leurs enjeux métier, anticiper leurs besoins et proposer des recommandations proactives pour maximiser l'adoption de la solution.

  • KPIs : maîtrise de l’écosystème comptable, concurrentiel et de la réforme de la facturation électronique à M+3. CSAT > 9/10 à M+6

Conduite du changement & suivi de l'adoption

  • Définir et piloter la stratégie d'embarquement adaptée à chaque cabinet depuis la phase pilote jusqu’au déploiement et proposer des plans d'action correctifs le cas échéant

  • Accompagner les collaborateurs comptables dans la prise en main de Pennylane en analyant les indicateurs d'adoption en phase de déploiement et identifier les risques en amont.

  • KPIs : taux d'adoption des collaborateurs des cabinets conforme aux objectifs fixés avec les cabinets en fin de pilote ou déploiement

Contribution à l'amélioration continue

  • Challenger les process et outils de gestion de projet existants, proposer des améliorations concrètes et les déployer en équipe.

  • KPIs : premier retour structuré sur les process et rapport d’étonnement pertinent à M+3

🎯 Ce que l'on recherche ?

Must have

  • 5 à 8 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet complexe, transformation digitale ou conseil (cabinet ou ESN).

  • Expérience avérée de la gestion de projets multi-interlocuteurs à forte dimension stratégique.

  • Excellente capacité à construire et entretenir des relations de confiance avec des profils décisionnaires exigeants.

  • Maîtrise des outils et méthodologies de gestion de projet (planning, gestion des risques, reporting).

  • Sens aigu du conseil : tu sais amener tes interlocuteurs vers la bonne solution avec diplomatie et conviction.

Nice to have

  • Expérience dans le secteur de l'expertise comptable, de l'audit ou de la Fintech/SaaS B2B.

  • Bases comptables ou compréhension des enjeux de la transformation digitale en cabinet d’expertise comptable.

  • Expérience en conduite du changement.

Ce qui fera la différence

  • Un profil qui sait être à la fois rigoureux sur la méthode et agile dans l'exécution.

  • Une vraie envie de construire, d'améliorer et de laisser une empreinte sur les process de l'équipe.

  • Une posture naturellement orientée conseil et accompagnement, pas uniquement delivery.

 

🤝 Process de recrutement

  • Premier échange avec Simon, notre recruteur - 30min

  • Entretien Who avec Aurélie Djoki (Team Lead Project Manager Key Account) - 45min

  • Étude de cas et debriefing avec Arnaud BERNARD (Head of Key Account) et Aurélie - 1h

  • Entretien final avec Tristan LENOIR (Directeur Partner Success) - 45min

🎁 Ce qu'on peut t'offrir ?

💵 Package : Fixe + Variable

🏥 Une mutuelle très complète (Alan Blue)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏢 De supers bureaux en plein centre de Paris (Wework Liège)

🏝 10 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🏃‍♀️Un accès à 8000 salles de sport et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via Gymlib

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Et enfin, l'opportunité de rejoindre une équipe internationale et dynamique : Nous faisons de nombreux sports ensemble (Foot, footing, escalade... etc), nous adorons passer du temps autour d'un verre, et les deux séminaires d'entreprise annuels (Hossegor, Les deux Alpes, Avignon récemment...) sont des grands moments de cohésion.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou @pennylane-partners.com .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

jobs.title: VP Clinical Development
jobs.description:
🏨 The Company

Resilience is a global, clinical-stage medtech company specializing in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry. We develop digital solutions that transform patient care and generate robust clinical data to improve treatments. As a true sponsor, we are conducting multiple prospective randomized clinical trials to obtain regulatory approvals in Europe and the United States.


📝 Your Role

In a nutshell:

The Vice President, Clinical Development will own and lead all sponsor-led clinical development activities at Resilience across oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry.

This role is accountable for the strategic direction, design, and execution of Resilience-sponsored clinical trials and real-world evidence programs, ensuring consistency, scientific rigor, operational excellence, and regulatory readiness across all business units.

Reporting to the Chief Medical Officer, the VP Clinical Development will build and lead a centralized Clinical Development organization, composed of Clinical Leads and Clinical Scientists, and will serve as the single point of accountability for clinical development execution at the company level.


Key Responsibilities

  • Clinical Development Ownership (Core accountability)

    • Own the end-to-end clinical development strategy and execution for all Resilience-sponsored studies

    • Provide senior clinical leadership on:

      • study design and methodology

      • protocol development and amendments

      • endpoint selection and clinical relevance

      • interpretation of clinical and real-world evidence

    • Ensure alignment and consistency of clinical development approaches across oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry

  • Team Leadership & Organization

    • Build, lead, and mentor a Clinical Development team composed of:

      • Clinical Leads (by therapeutic area)

      • Clinical Scientists

    • Define clear roles, responsibilities, and governance across the team

    • Establish scalable ways of working enabling high-quality, timely execution

  • Portfolio Governance & Standardization

    • Design and implement standardized clinical development frameworks across business units

    • Harmonize:

      • protocol templates and study documentation

      • clinical review and governance processes

      • decision criteria and escalation pathways

    • Ensure alignment with ICH-GCP, ISO 14155, MDR, and applicable regulatory standards

  • Operational Excellence & Inspection Readiness

    • Ensure inspection readiness across all sponsor-led trials

    • Partner closely with Clinical Operations to:

      • drive execution excellence and risk anticipation

      • ensure quality-by-design principles

      • resolve complex operational or scientific issues

    • Act as senior escalation point for clinical development matters

  • Cross-Functional Leadership

    • Collaborate closely with:

    • Regulatory & Quality (clinical strategy, submissions, audits)

      • Biostatistics (study design, endpoints, analysis plans)

      • Medical Affairs (scientific alignment and evidence narratives)

      • Market Access & Public Affairs (clinical evidence support)

      • Product and Data teams (translation of clinical insights into digital solutions)

    • Ensure clinical development is tightly integrated with company-wide priorities

👤 Candidate Profile

  • A strategic thinker with the ability to prioritize in complex environments

  • An inspiring leader with a talent for developing your teams

  • Executive presence with strong scientific credibility

  • Cross-functional minded with ability to collaborate with multiple stakeholders

  • Comfortable with innovation (digital health, non-traditional endpoints)

  • An excellent communicator and presenter

📃 You're the right person if you have already:

  • An MD MSc or MD PhD degree

  • Minimum 5 years of clinical development experience on the sponsor side (biotech/pharma)

  • Proven experience managing and scaling clinical development teams

  • Strong understanding of regulatory and inspection requirements

  • Worked in international contexts (EU/US regulatory exposure)

Nice to have: Experience in digital therapeutics or biotechs that have obtained CE/FDA approvals.

💛 Why join us?

  • Direct impact on the company's clinical governance: you will build Resilience's clinical engine from scratch

  • Cross-therapeutic exposure: oncology, psychiatry, gastroenterology

  • Strategic interaction with executive leadership: you will work directly with the CMO and CEO

  • Ambitious scale-up environment: combines scientific rigor, digital innovation, and regulatory ambition

3️⃣ Recruitment Process

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer (Launcher)
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

Overview

Harmattan AI is developing new hardware products within the Launcher module: field-deployable drone launchers designed to be deployed and operated autonomously in demanding field environments. These products require dedicated electronics design with complex architecture in a constrained environment – PCBs integrating power conversion, energy management, control and communication interfaces – optimised for cost at volume. The Launcher team is seeking a dedicated hardware engineer to own electronics design end-to-end and accelerate the path to production milestones.

Ideal candidate

A senior hardware engineer who has designed and shipped complex PCBs, ideally mixing digital and significant power (hundreds of watts), into production. They are rigorous on schematics, layout, and bring-up, and have a strong instinct for cost and manufacturability. They design with real-world operating conditions in mind - temperature, moisture, surges - and an interest in battery thermal management; direct experience of outdoor-deployed equipment is a plus rather than a prerequisite. They are comfortable working autonomously in a small team and can bridge hardware and firmware.

Skills required

  • PCB schematic and layout design (Altium Designer preferred)

  • Power electronics design: ~300 W DC/DC conversion, protection, derating, efficiency and thermal budgets

  • Thermal regulation: temperature sensing and control loops, battery storage temperature management, heatsinking

  • Power over Ethernet (IEEE 802.3af/at/bt): combined power and data delivery, isolation, cable budgets

  • Mixed-signal design: power management, MCU interfaces, communication buses (SPI, I2C, UART, USB, CAN, Ethernet)

  • Hardware bring-up and debug: bench equipment proficiency

  • DFM/DFA for PCB manufacturing and assembly

  • Component selection and BOM management

  • Experience in lightning and surge protection is a plus

Responsibilities:

  • Schematic Design - Design complete schematics for mixed-signal and power boards, from power stages to digital and communication sections.

  • PCB Layout & Routing - Perform or lead board placement and routing with attention to signal integrity, EMC, and power-path constraints.

  • Power & Thermal Architecture - Define and validate the power architecture of the product and the thermal strategy, including battery temperature management.

  • Environmental Robustness - Ensure the electronics withstand outdoor deployment conditions and define the associated qualification plan.

  • Component Selection & BOM Optimization - Select components with cost, availability, and reliability in mind; drive BOM cost reduction for mass production volumes.

  • Hardware Bring-up & Debug - Lead board bring-up, debug issues with oscilloscopes, power bench equipment, and other bench equipment; write bring-up scripts when needed.

  • EMC & Safety Compliance - Address EMC challenges; ensure signal integrity across the board and electrical safety of the power and battery sections.

  • Collaboration with Embedded SW - Work closely with the embedded software engineer to define hardware/software interfaces; support firmware bring-up.

  • Collaboration with Mechanical - Ensure seamless PCB integration into mechanical enclosures (connectors, mounting, thermal, sealing, shielding).

  • Supplier & Manufacturing Ramp-up - Qualify PCB manufacturers and assembly houses; support DFM/DFA review for production; manage NPI transitions.

  • Documentation - Maintain schematics, layout files, test procedures, and hardware specifications.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer (Electronic Warfare)
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Hardware (Electronics) Engineer within our Electronic Warfare team, you will design and develop the RF hardware and electronic front-ends at the core of our electronic warfare and signal intelligence systems – from concept to field deployment. You will work hand-in-hand with system, software and mechanical teams to turn architecture needs into robust, high-performance hardware, and to ensure overall performance, robustness and reliability.

Responsibilities

  • RF Front-End Design: Design and develop radio and radar RF front-ends, from specification through to validation.

  • Hardware Architecture: Drive the hardware architecture of EW/SIGINT systems, ensuring performance, robustness and manufacturability.

  • High-Power & High-Voltage Electronics: Design high-power switching supplies (including narrow pulse generation) and high-voltage PCBs, supplies and shielding.

  • Integration & Validation: Lead board bring-up, RF integration, prototyping and validation against performance targets.

  • Technical Coordination: Collaborate across software, mechanical, GNC and ML teams on system integration and technical interfaces.

  • System Reviews & Documentation: Contribute to design and architecture reviews, maintaining consistency between requirements, design and testing.

Candidate Requirements

  • Strong background in RF hardware design is mandatory, including radio or radar front-end design.

  • No prior Electronic Warfare experience required.

  • Experience in RF integration is a plus.

  • Experience with high-power switching supplies (narrow pulse generation) is a definite plus.
