jobs.title: Director, Business Development
jobs.description:
About TransPerfect

TransPerfect is the world's largest privately held provider of language services and technology solutions. With over 100 offices globally and more than 5,000 full-time employees, we work with the world's leading organisations across Legal, Corporate, Life Sciences, Financial, and Creative sectors to help them communicate, operate, and grow across languages, cultures, and markets.

 

Following our acquisition of The Mill — one of the world's most acclaimed creative studios — TransPerfect now offers an expanded suite of creative production services, including Artistic Direction, VFX, and Motion Design, serving luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands globally.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to join our Corporate vertical in France. This is a pure new business hunter role — your mission is to identify, prospect, and close net new accounts across TransPerfect's full portfolio of services.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

What You Will Sell

You will represent TransPerfect's full Corporate service portfolio, including:

  • Translation & Localisation** — documents, marketing, legal, technical, and digital content

  • Interpretation** — simultaneous, consecutive, remote (RSI)

  • Technology & AI Solutions** — GlobalLink TMS, MT/MTPE, AI-powered workflows

  • Digital & Multimedia** — subtitling, dubbing, voice-over, e-learning localisation

  • Creative Production (The Mill)** — Artistic Direction, VFX, Motion Design for luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands

  • Globalisation Consulting** — content strategy, workflow optimisation, language asset management

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a pipeline of net new business across the French and European corporate market

  • Identify and engage key decision-makers — CMOs, Heads of Communication, Procurement Directors, Creative Directors, and Heads of Production

  • Develop tailored pitches and proposals that draw on the full breadth of TransPerfect's service offering, including creative capabilities

  • Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including RFP/RFI responses, commercial negotiation, and contract finalisation

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Solutions, Operations, The Mill creative teams) to design compelling, client-specific solutions

  • Represent TransPerfect at industry events, trade shows, and networking forums

  • Contribute to market intelligence — identify trends, competitor movements, and emerging client needs

  • Report pipeline, forecast, and activity accurately


Experience

  • Minimum 3–7 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record in new business development

  • Experience selling , multi-service solutions to corporate clients — ideally in one or more of the following: creative services, digital production, marketing services, SaaS/tech, or professional services

  • Proven ability to close six-figure deals and manage multi-stakeholder, long-cycle sales processes

  • Exposure to or genuine interest in creative industries (luxury, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, advertising) — a strong differentiator

  • Experience navigating large organisations — identifying budget holders, managing procurement processes, and building internal champions

 

Skills & Competencies

  • Hunter profile— proactive, autonomous, energised by opening new doors

  • Ability to sell both transactional and strategic engagements depending on client maturity

  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills— listens before pitching

jobs.title: Scientist within data-driven and numerical ocean modeling
jobs.description:
About the roles

Modern meteorology and oceanography requires management and analysis of enormous amounts of data, and offers great and exciting professional challenges. Since the institute was established in 1866, Norwegian meteorologists and scientists have played a key role in this development.


The Norwegian Meteorological Institute (MET Norway) is today an internationally leading operational forecast and research institution with expertise in operational meteorology, oceanography and climate science. The primary area of interest coincides with the national focus area, northern Europe, North Atlantic and the Arctic. The division for Ocean and Ice conducts world class research and operates 24/7 forecasting of storm surge, ocean currents, hydrography, and sea-ice on regional to coastal scales. As well as multi-decadal hindcasts and reanalyses. These models provide input to downstream services such as oil spill drift models and search-and-rescue support. The work is carried out in collaboration with national and international partners.
 

MET Norway utilizes the Regional Ocean Modeling System (ROMS) as the dynamic core for our operational forecasting systems, primarily the Norkyst and Barents models. These high-resolution tools provide essential data on ocean currents, storm surges, and sea-ice, supporting diverse marine operations, research, and downstream services like oil spill drift modeling and search-and-rescue. We continuously advance these capabilities through close collaboration with the Institute of Marine Research (IMR) and international partners, with current efforts focused on consolidating our common model code base and developing new high-resolution domains for the Barents Sea and Svalbard.


Data-driven methods have a great potential for making our ocean and sea-ice forecasting systems more computationally efficient, and also make them more accessible for cross-disciplinary work relevant to marine ecosystems and the blue economy. We also acknowledge that other institutions, both in Norway and abroad, are investing substantial resources in the development of data-driven methods relevant to our core mandate, and it is therefore essential to establish and maintain strong links with other groups in the field. We are therefore announcing a permanent position for a scientist focusing on both data-driven ocean modeling, science dissemination, and external collaboration on methods developments. The successful candidates will be employed at the Division of Ocean and Ice in Oslo and collaborate with experienced scientists at MET Norway as well as partner institutions in Norway and abroad.


Position 1: Data-Driven Ocean Modeling

The successful candidate will work in externally financed projects to develop data-driven ocean models for prediction and coastal downscaling. Using Graph Neural Networks and similar machine learning techniques trained on archives of dynamic ocean models, the candidate will create hyper-resolution models relevant to cross-disciplinary research, such as marine ecosystems, and decision-making tools for the blue economy and coastal governance.


Position 2: Numerical Ocean Modeling

The successful candidate will join the Ocean and Ice division to play a pivotal role in the development of our next-generation models based on the Regional Ocean Modeling System. Responsibilities include the full lifecycle of model development: from defining domains and creating necessary input data, to rigorous testing, operationalization, evaluation, and dissemination of results.


Qualifications and Expected Experience 
  • PhD in oceanography, meteorology, physics, cybernetics or applied mathematics is required
  • Sound understanding of physical oceanography and experience in numerical modeling 
  • Knowledge of general machine learning methods, and in particular application of data-driven prediction for geophysical applications
  • Knowledge of contemporary ocean modeling and data assimilation techniques is required 
  • The candidate should bring an established network in relevant science fields 
  • Proven experience with science dissemination and outreach is required 
  • Success with peer-review publishing of results is required
  • Particular emphasis will be given on the candidates ability to work as part of a team

Expected Technical skills 
  • Experience in software development and scientific data analysis in Python is required and knowledge of Fortran is beneficial
  • Experience and proven knowledge in applied mathematics/scientific programming in the Linux environment is required 
  • Experience with python-based tools for data-driven prediction (e.g. Pytorch, Anemoi, etc) is required for position #1, and beneficial for position #2
  • Knowledge in handling geophysical data formats and libraries (e.g. Netcdf, CF-conventions, zarr, xarray)
  • Experience with high performance computing is required for both positions. Additionally, experience with the application of GPU infrastructure is required for position #1
  • Experience with software version control (e.g. git) or similar project management tools is required
  • Fluency in English, as well as good command of Norwegian (or willingness to learn Norwegian) is required
  • Independence and self-motivation as well as excellent work ethic and commitment to the job are expected

We offer
  • Salary on the Norwegian governmental salary scales dependent on qualifications and experience (NOK 720.000 - 810.000 pr. year, higher salary can be negotiated for particularily qualified candidates)
  • Flexible working conditions
  • Membership in Statens pensjonskasse (SPK), the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (2% deducted from gross salary), one of the best pension funds in Norway
  • Good insurances and mortgage benefits through SPK
  • A pleasant working environment
  • The first six months are a mutual probitionary period

Diversity and positive action

We emphasize diversity and therefore encourage all those who are qualified to apply - regardless of age, gender, functional capacity, ethnic background or gaps in the resume. Met practises positive action, and will invite at least one qualified applicant from each of the following groups to an interview: applicants with a disability, an immigrant background, or a gap in their CV. To be considered under one or more og these categories, please mark the relevant categories in your application. 

If in any case an applicant does not wish to be registered on the public application list, the applicant will need to give a reasonably argued justification. Information about the applicant can still be published. If the wish to not be registered on the public application list is denied, the applicant will be informed prior to the disclosure.


The application

The application with CV and other attachments is sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. Attach certificates and all pages of diplomas. The documents should preferably be in Norwegian, a Scandinavian language or English. Translations must be authorized. 

Before any employment, we will check the documents. In the case of foreign education, we ask that you attach an explanation of the grading system.

Meteorologisk Institutt varsler været, overvåker klima og driver samfunnskritisk forskning. Vi har levert kritiske, meteorologiske tjenester til det norske samfunnet i over 150 år. Vi sørger for at redningshelikoptre kommer trygt frem, og at beredskapsetatene er forberedt på ekstremvær og annet farlig vær. jobs.title: Project Controller
jobs.description:
Project Controller position available

The Chr. Michelsen Institute (CMI) has one, 100%, permanent Project Controller position available. CMI is a private research institute with English as the working language.

This position replaces a team member who is transitioning to a new role. 

The position is part of the Project Unit within the institute's Administration and reports to the Head of Projects. The Project Unit works across CMI to facilitate research and commissioned projects throughout their lifecycle by providing expert advice in grant management and project administration.

The preferred start date is January/February 2027. 


Job description and essential work tasks

As a Project Controller, you will work as part of the Project Unit at CMI with responsibility for a dedicated project portfolio, ensuring sustainable operations and continuous professional development of oneself and the unit.

The Project Unit is responsible for: 

  • The full lifecycle of research projects, including budgeting, financial monitoring, reporting, invoicing, contracts, and project close-out.
  • Compliance with funding regulations and legislation, contribute to the continuous development of grant management practices, and foster collaboration and knowledge sharing within the Project Unit and across the Institute.
  • Supporting application processes by providing administrative, financial, and compliance expertise.
  • Monitoring the market for commissioned research opportunities. 

Key work tasks in the Project Controller role

  • Provide financial and administrative oversight of research projects throughout their entire lifecycle, from the proposal stage to project completion.
  • Collaborate and communicate closely with researchers involved in the research projects within your assigned project portfolio.
  • Provide professional and administrative support for grant applications and tenders to national and international funding bodies and clients; contributing to the development of new project proposals.
  • Prepare project budgets, financial reports, invoices, and process financial documentation.
  • Manage the formal and legal aspects of agreements and contracts, including further developing and adapting contract templates.
  • Ensure the quality of administrative and financial reporting to funding agencies and clients.

What We Are Looking for in a Project Controller

Experience and Qualifications

  • A higher education degree in a relevant field.
  • Experience in project administration and financial control.
  • Understanding of grant compliance, funding regulations, and research administration.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Norwegian and English.
  • Experience with funding programmes from the Research Council of Norway and the European Union is an advantage.
  • Experience with commissioned work acquisition and bid management is an advantage. 

Personal skills

You are a proactive and solution-oriented professional who works effectively both independently and as part of diverse teams. 

You are organised, able to manage competing priorities and deadlines, communicate clearly and professionally, and are comfortable navigating digital systems and administrative processes. 

You enjoy learning, adapting to new requirements, and following through to deliver results.


CMI can offer you:
  • The opportunity to be part of knowledge organization contributing to societal change. 
  • A vibrant and international working environment, with English as the primary working language.
  • Work-life balance and home office opportunities.
  • This position is placed either in the Adviser or Senior Adviser category, wage is determined by the position category and the candidate's experience. 
  • Salary for Adviser positions starts at NOK 688 271.-
  • Salary for Senior Adviser positions starts at NOK 787 831.- . 

Relevant staff benefits:

  • In addition, to the annual 5 weeks holiday leave, CMI offers staff additional paid leave from the 24th of December to the 1st of January, and during the Easter week each year.
  • Support for gym membership.
  • Excellent travel insurance that covers both work and private travel (terms apply).
  • Defined contribution pension (innskuddspension). Contributions are paid with 7% of the salary up to 7.1 G and 25.1% of the salary between 7.1-12 G (2% are deducted from the employee, terms apply).

Location 

This position is located in Bergen, Norway. CMI is not in a position to offer remote working arrangements for new staff members. We offer home office agreements, allowing all staff to work up to two days a week from home office in Norway.


How to apply:

CMI only accepts applications through the JobbNorge recruitment system.

Please submit the following:

  • A cover page outlining your motivation for the position, and your qualification for the role
  • CV
  • Proof of highest degree received (i.e., copy of diploma or transcript)
  • A minimum of three references, including phone numbers and e-mail addresses

The application deadline is set to the: 15th of October 2026. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

CMI is an independent, development research institute based in Bergen, Norway, with around 110 staff members. In cooperation with partners from all over the world, we address key development challenges in Africa, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Latin America.

We combine high-quality research with an engagement to make knowledge accessible and used. We work in multi-disciplinary teams, where the main disciplines are economics, political science, and social anthropology. We have an international staff and an engaging working environment.

Our vision is 'research for a just and equal world', and our mission is to address global challenges by providing research-based knowledge that inspires and shapes policy and practice.

Our values are: inclusive & empathetic, collaborative, curious & bold and respectful. You can read CMI's strategy, vision, mission and values in full here: Who we are (cmi.no). 

CMI's strategic priorities for 2023-2028 are:

  • High-quality research: increasingly be internationally recognized for cutting edge, interdisciplinary academic and policy-relevant research.
  • Impact for societal change: To strengthen our influence, and shape public debates and policies in our fields of expertise.
  • Equal knowledge production: To be a role model in equal and inclusive partnerships in all of our endeavors.

CMI's structural priorities for 2023-2028 are:

  • An inclusive workplace: CMI must have an inclusive and healthy work culture that encourages and thrives on diversity, including in perspectives.
  • A developing & sustainable organization: CMI continues to adapt to changing needs and requirements by having sufficient staff with the right competencies, resources, and technology to support our operations.
  • Social responsibility: CMI works for sustainability in all areas of our operations, especially those focused on environmental, social and governance issues.

jobs.title: Postdoc Researcher in Resilient Edge Computing for Critical Infrastructure
jobs.employer: RISE Research Institutes of Sweden AB
jobs.description:
The Project

This position is part of CIRES (Critical Infrastructure Resilience through Edge Computing Systems), a European research project funded under the Chips Joint Undertaking. CIRES addresses a fundamental and urgent challenge: how to design distributed digital infrastructures that remain operational, secure, and trustworthy under failures, cyber attacks, degraded connectivity, and large-scale disruptions.

Modern critical infrastructure increasingly relies on tightly coupled edge computing, distributed communication networks, and cloud coordination. While these architectures offer autonomy and scalability, they also introduce complex failure modes and new attack surfaces. CIRES develops next-generation resilient edge-cloud architectures with a focus on secure communication, distributed coordination, adaptive service continuity, and rapid recovery under adverse conditions.

The project brings together leading European research institutes, universities, and industrial partners, offering an opportunity to address scientifically challenging distributed systems problems while contributing to technologies that safeguard essential societal infrastructure.

About the Role

As a postdoctoral researcher in CIRES, you will develop network and system mechanisms that keep critical infrastructure services running when connectivity and power are degraded or disrupted. The work combines protocol and architecture design with implementation and experimental validation in real environments, together with the project's application partners.

Key responsibilities include:

    

Designing resilient network protocols and architectures that work across connectivity conditions, from well-connected, high-capacity networks to intermittently connected, delay- and disruption-tolerant networks (DTN), and adapt to the conditions at hand

    

Applying these mechanisms so that sensors, IoT and other low-power devices, user devices, and edge systems keep sufficient communication services during disruptions to communication and power infrastructure

    

Developing methods for offloading computation between end devices, edge, and cloud based on available resources and current and predicted service needs, together with efficient data collection and caching

    

Contributing to robust AI/ML and data analysis methods that support resilient decision making when only partial data is available

    

Integrating solutions with partners' software and platforms and evaluating them in large-scale tests in real environments

    

Publishing results in leading international conferences and journals

    

Contributing to EU project deliverables and technical reporting

    

Collaborating with industrial and academic partners across Europe

You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team and engage with industrial partners to validate solutions in relevant environments.

What We Offer

This position provides a strong platform for building an internationally visible research career. Specifically, you will benefit from:

    

The opportunity to publish in leading international venues in distributed systems and networking

    

Influence over technical direction within your research area

    

Access to realistic deployment environments and industrial validation scenarios

    

Participation in large-scale European research collaboration across industry and academia

    

Exposure to the full research-to-deployment pipeline within critical infrastructure contexts

    

Career development support toward senior roles in academia, research institutes, or industrial R&D

The position is a full-time, fixed-term appointment for two years, starting as soon as possible, designed to support your career development. You will gain experience in large-scale European collaboration, applied research in critical infrastructure, and direct interaction with industrial stakeholders. Travel is included in the role, primarily within Europe, with an estimated 3-4 international trips per year for consortium meetings, workshops, and conferences.

Who Are You?

Requirements:

    

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field

    

Strong background in networked and distributed systems, for example network protocols, wireless or IoT networking, or edge computing

    

Experience in system design and experimental evaluation

    

Demonstrated ability to publish scientific research

    

Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, C/C++, or equivalent)

    

Excellent written and spoken English

Meriting:

    

Experience with EU-funded research projects

    

Experience with robust or distributed AI/ML, for example federated learning

    

Experience with delay- and disruption-tolerant, opportunistic, or mesh networking

    

Familiarity with containerization, virtualization, or distributed deployment environments

    

Experience with computation offloading, caching, or edge resource management

    

Experience with testbeds or real-world deployments, including low-power IoT devices

    

Familiarity with semiconductor or embedded hardware platforms

    

Experience collaborating with industrial partners

Personal qualities:

We are looking for a researcher who combines intellectual rigour with practical systems thinking. We value:

    

Strong analytical capability and independent problem-solving

    

Ability to drive research forward with initiative and self-leadership

    

Collaborative mindset in multidisciplinary, international environments

    

Clear and structured communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

    

Curiosity, technical depth, and motivation to work on challenging problems with real-world relevance

jobs.title: Helsefagarbeider hjemmesykepleien
jobs.description:
Hjemmetjenesten team 5 / Åssiden trenger flere helsefagarbeidere, enten nyutdannet eller med erfaring.  

Hos oss får du brukt faget på en variert måte, og blir en del av et team med erfarne, trygge og dedikerte kolleger. Vi har høyt faglig engasjement og et godt arbeidsmiljø. Vi vil at brukere, pårørende og samarbeidspartnere skal oppleve oss som kompetente og profesjonelle. Vi gjør hverandre gode gjennom åpenhet, erfaringsdeling, refleksjon og stor takhøyde for latter.  

Tjenester til hjemmeboende nord yter mangfoldige tjenester og ivaretar de fleste trinnene i omsorgstrappen. Virksomheten består av hjemmesykepleie og praktisk bistand. Et samarbeide på tvers og og tverrfaglighet er grunnpilarer for oss. Derfor har vi samlokalisert våre 4 hjemmesykepleieteam til et større fagmiljø, og vi har alle kontorer i Mjøndalen sentrum. 

I hjemmetjenesten jobber vi aktivt med å tilpasse organisering og tjenestetilbud etter dagens samfunn.  Vi har et eget sykepleierteam som bidrar med faglig kompetanse og kollegalæring, og et fagteam bestående av allmensykepleiere, kreftkoordinatorer og demenskoordinatorer som bistår med sin kompetanse i komplekse caser. 

Blir du vår nye kollega vil du den første tiden utføre arbeidsoppgaver med en kollega, og vi planlegger opplæringen sammen. Du jobber på dag- og kveldstid og i snitt tredje hver helg.  Dersom du ønsker å jobbe langvakter 4.hver helg er det mulighet for det.

For stillinger der det er krav om politiattest, etter gjeldende lover vil dette bli innhentet i forbindelse med signering av arbeidsavtalen, før tiltredelse.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Utføre direkte pleie- og omsorgsoppgaver i tråd med gjeldende krav til kvalitet, lovverk, kommunale retningslinjer og faglig god praksis
  • Ansvar for en primærbrukere
  • Tverrfaglig samarbeid
  • Samarbeid med pårørende
  • Veiledning av elever og pleiemedarbeidere
  • Dokumentasjonsplikt, vi bruker Gerica og LMP som dokumentasjon
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Autorisasjon som helsefagarbeider / hjelpepleier
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Erfaring fra hjemmesykepleie er en fordel, men ikke et krav
  • For søkere med annen utdanning enn norsk, kreves dokumenterte språkkunnskaper skriftlig og muntlig på nivå B1. Dette gjelder ikke skandinaviske søkere. Dokumentasjon vedlegges søknaden.
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er opptatt av kvalitet og bidrar aktivt i forbedringsarbeidet
  • Du tar ansvar og følger opp delegerte arbeidsoppgaver
  • Du er strukturert. Du må kunne jobbe selvstendig, men kunne tenke sammen med dine kollegaer
  • Du er kreativ og ser løsninger i forhold til arbeidsoppgaver
  • Du har gode samarbeidsevner, er fleksibel og mestrer høyt tempo
Vi tilbyr
  • Fast stilling i 100%, med mulighet for langvakt på helg
  • Gode muligheter for kompetanseutvikling både på eksterne og interne kurs, også gjennom relevant videreutdanning
  • Et godt og stabilt arbeidsmiljø med mye kompetanse og trivsel på jobb
  • En spennende og lærerik arbeidsplass hvor vi spiller hverandre gode
  • Lønn etter sentrale lønns- og stillingsregulativer
  • Tiltredelse: etter avtale

Vedlagt søknaden legges relevante vitnemål og attester. Vitnemålsportalen skal benyttes for vitnemål som er registrert i denne portalen. Har du utdanning fra utlandet legger du ved godkjenning fra Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse. 

I henhold til Offentleglova kan vi være forpliktet til å offentliggjøre opplysninger om søkere som har bedt om å bli unntatt offentlighet.

Tamashii betyder “sjæl” på japansk, og køkkenet bliver moderne asiatisk med Henrik Jyrks personlige aftryk. Ambitionen er høj, med teknik og råvarekvalitet i den skarpe ende, men uden den formalitet, der ofte forbindes med fine dining.

Fra køkken og service til vinkort og indretning er Tamashii skabt med en ambition om at nå Michelin-niveau.

Om Norrlyst Koncernen

Norrlyst Koncernen står bag nogle af Københavns mest markante restauranter og vinbarer. Fælles for vores steder er en kompromisløs tilgang til kvalitet, stærkt værtskab og et ønske om at skabe oplevelser, der både føles professionelle og personlige.

Vi tror på, at gode baroplevelser skabes af mennesker, der elsker faget. Derfor giver vi plads til udvikling, ansvar og engagement – og vi værdsætter både faglighed og god energi højt i vores teams.

Rollen

Som bartender bliver du en vigtig del af barens daglige drift og gæsteoplevelse.

Du arbejder i et miljø med højt tempo og høje standarder, hvor du er med til at sikre, at gæsterne får en oplevelse, der er både effektiv, nærværende og velfungerende.

Du laver cocktails, serverer vin og drikkevarer og er samtidig med til at skabe den stemning, som gør baren til et sted, gæsterne har lyst til at blive hængende.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Har erfaring som bartender – gerne fra en travl og ambitiøs bar eller restaurant.

  • Har solid forståelse for cocktails, spiritus og/eller vin.

  • Trives i et højt tempo og bevarer overblikket i service.

  • Er udadvendt, imødekommende og god til at skabe kontakt til gæster.

  • Er en holdspiller, der bidrager til god energi bag baren.

  • Har lyst til at udvikle dine færdigheder og blive endnu skarpere i faget.

Vi tilbyder

  • En plads i en ny og ambitiøs bar i hjertet af København.

  • En hverdag med højt tempo, stærkt fællesskab og dygtige kolleger.

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling inden for bar, cocktails og service.

  • Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på kvalitet, energi og godt samarbejde.

  • Attraktive løn- og ansættelsesvilkår.

  • Personalefordele på tværs af Norrlyst Koncernens restauranter og vinbarer.

Hvis du elsker faget, trives i et levende miljø og vil være en del af en bar med ambitioner, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Heimetenesta
jobs.description:
Om avdelinga og stillinga:

Heimetenesta i Øygarden kommune er under kommunalsjefområde helse og velferd og er inndelt i fire avdelingar, Skogsvåg, Ågotnes, Straume og Bildøy. Som sjukepleiar i heimetenesta vil ein jobbe tett på brukarane i deira heim og møte dei i ulike livssituasjonar og ulike utfordringar. I heimetenesta jobbar ein strukturert innanfor geografiske avdelingar i team og aleine. Vi treng deg som er ein kompetent sjukepleiar som kan utføre tildelte oppgåver i brukars heim. Vi ønskjer at du er fagleg dyktig og engasjert i oppgåver som du vil møte.

Avdeling Ågotnes har ledig stilling som sjukepleiar. Stillinga er ledig frå november 2026

Sjukepleiar 100% fast der 25% er knytt til timebank.

Kven ser vi etter?

Til stillinga ser vi etter deg som trivs med mange ballar i lufta, som er robust og positiv på krevjande dagar og som trivs best når du arbeider i eit aktivt miljø. Du kommuniserer og samarbeider godt med dine kollegaer. Som sjukepleiar i heimetenesta får du høve til å utfordre, utvikle og tileigne deg mykje erfaring og kunnskap i ei teneste som stadig er under utvikling og vekst. Vi har fokus på å gje brukaren god livskvalitet, oppretthalde eigne ressursar og gje dei høve til å bu heime så lenge som mogleg gjennom førebyggjande behandling/ tiltak.

Kva får du hos oss?

Som vår nye kollega vil du kunna få 80 - 100% fast stilling i årsturnus med 16 arbeidshelger (eventuelt fleire mot kompensasjon), årleg fagdag, internundervisning og mentorordning for nytilsette. Du vil møte motiverte og kunnskapsrike kollega, interessante utfordringar og ha høve til personleg og fagleg utvikling. Som tilsett hos oss vil du òg ha gode pensjons – og forsikringsordningar. Du har høve til å søke startlån utan krav om genkapital gjennom kommunen, dette kan du lese meir om på kommunens heimeside Startlån

Kven er så du?

Du har autorisasjon som sjukepleiar, har førarkort og om du har erfaring frå heimetenesta er det ein fordel. Du har gode norskkunnskapar og beherskar språket både munnleg og skriftleg. Du er strukturert og evnar å halde oversikt. Vi legg vekt på personleg eignaheit. Du må kunne arbeide sjølvstendig og saman med andre samt bidra til eit godt arbeidsmiljø. Du trivs med å tenke nytt, samstundes som du tar vare på dei gode løysingane som allereie eksisterer.

Som vår nye kollega er det viktig at du kjenner deg igjen i våre verdiar; omsorg, livsglede, mot, raus og engasjement.

Om du kjenner deg igjen, bli med oss på laget!

Anna:

Sjukepleiarar i turnus i Øygarden kommune er løna kr 35 000 per år over tariff.

Kontakt:

Ass. Einingsleiar Kate S. Løland, tlf 56160502 / 950 71 121

Øygarden kommune ønskjer eit arbeidsmiljø prega av mangfald, og at våre medarbeidarar i størst mogleg grad skal spegla mangfaldet i befolkninga. Vi oppmodar alle som er kvalifiserte til å søkja jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, eller minoritetsbakgrunn. Som IA-verksemd ønskjer kommunen å leggja til rette for arbeidsforholda dersom du har behov for det.

Etter utløpet til søknadsfristen, vert det sett opp ei offentleg søkjarliste med namn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bustads- eller arbeidskommune for kvar søkjar. Det kan gjerast unntak frå innsyn for opplysningar om ein søkjar dersom vedkomande sjølv ber om det. Opplysningar om ein søkjar, kan verta offentlege sjølv om søkjaren har bede om ikkje å vert ført opp på søkjarlista. Dersom oppmodinga ikkje vert teken til følgje, vert søkjaren varsla om dette. Ved vurderinga av om ei slik oppmoding skal takast til følgje, skal det leggjast vekt på om det knyter seg særleg offentleg interesse til stillinga.

Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Øygarden kommune er den nest største kommunen i Vestland fylke med om lag 40 700 innbyggjarar og om lag 2 800 tilsette. Straume er kommunesenter (ca. 15 minutt køyring frå Bergen) med kommunedelsenter på Rong, Ågotnes og i Skogsskiftet. Administrasjonsspråket i Øygarden er nynorsk. Øygarden kommune har sett seg som mål å vera ein framtidsretta og kunnskapsbasert samfunnsutviklar med fortrinn innanfor energi, teknologi og marine ressursar. Kommunen skal løfta fram viktige verdiar som felles kultur, språk og identitet. Vi har ambisjonar om å vera ein handlekraftig og effektiv organisasjon med god leiing, høg kompetanse og kvalitet.

jobs.title: Socialsekreterare till mottagningsgruppen barn och unga, Danderyds kommun
jobs.description:
Har du ett stort engagemang för barn och ungdomar och vill vara med och göra verklig skillnad? Nu söker vi dig som vill bidra med din erfarenhet till  gruppen mottagning och tidigt stöd som är under uppbyggnad. Tillsammans får vi möjlighet att forma, utveckla och skapa något nytt från grunden. Vi hoppas att du vill bli en del av vår resa.

Socialförvaltningen befinner sig mitt i en kulturresa där vi tillsammans utvecklar framtidens socialtjänst med fokus på kvalitet, samarbete och invånarnas behov. Vi satsar på kompetensutveckling genom bland annat Yrkesresan och arbetar i moderna lokaler i Danderyds centrum.

Familjeavdelningen består av 42 medarbetare och ansvarar för socialtjänstens arbete med barn och unga, med undantag för insatser enligt LSS. Vi arbetar med rättssäker handläggning, tydliga rutiner och tidiga insatser för att ge barn och familjer rätt stöd i rätt tid.

Välkommen till en arbetsplats där gemenskap, utveckling och engagemang står i centrum. Vi hoppas att just du vill bli en del av vår fortsatta kulturresa!

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
I rollen som socialsekreterare i mottagningsgruppen arbetar du tillsammans med två socialsekreterarkollegor med att ta emot anmälningar och ansökningar gällande barn och ungdomar (0-20 år) samt genomföra förhandsbedömningar. I vissa fall ansvarar du för ärendet tills det kan överlämnas till utredningsgruppen. Rollen innefattar även att skriva LUL-yttranden samt vid behov handläggning och utredning.

Du samarbetar nära utredare, metodstödjare, familjebehandlare och gruppchef för att säkerställa att barn och familjer får det stöd de bedömer. Mottagningen är socialtjänstens ansikte utåt, vilket innebär att du också ger råd och vägledning samt informerar andra verksamheter om socialtjänstens arbete och insatser.

Vi samarbetar även med andra avdelningar inom socialförvaltningen, såsom vuxenavdelningens våld i nära relation och missbruksgrupp. På avdelningen arbetar även två administratörer som är till stor hjälp.

Vi sätter ett stort värde vid en rättssäker handläggning och har dokumenterade och lättillgängliga arbetsrutiner som är väl förankrade i arbetsgruppen som du kommer arbeta efter. Alla medarbetare förväntas delta i avdelningens kontinuerliga förbättringsarbete. Vi följer arbetsmiljön regelbundet för att säkerställa att arbetsbelastningen är rimlig och trivseln god. Vårt välutvecklade administrativa stöd avlastar personalen i det dagliga arbetet. Du kommer även att ha extern handledning var tredje vecka tillsammans med dina kollegor i respektive grupp. Alla nya medarbetare får en god introduktion.  

Vi är med i Socialstyrelsens yrkesresa. Yrkesresan är ett koncept för introduktion och kompetensutveckling för socialtjänstens medarbetare. Yrkesresan är framtagen genom ett samarbete mellan SKR, Socialstyrelsen och Regionala samverkans- och stödstrukturer (RSS).

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som har:

    •  Socionomexamen.
    •  God förmåga i det svenska språket i tal och skrift.
    • God förmåga avseende dokumentation.

Det är även meriterande om du har:

    • Erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning inom barn- och unga.
    • Goda kunskaper inom BBIC.
    • Goda kunskaper om FREDA-kortfrågor, iRiSk, Signs of safety.
    • Erfarenhet av familjerättsliga frågor samt att ha arbetat med familjer som har svåra relationskonflikter och där våld förekommer.
    • B-Körkort.

Vi söker dig som arbetar enligt en tydlig process och organiserar samt strukturerar upp ditt arbete väl. Vidare visar du på ett gott professionellt bemötande, är lugn, ansvarsfull, tydlig och flexibel. Du har en god samarbetsförmåga och är kontrollerad i stressiga situationer. Dessutom har du lätt för att anpassa dig till ändrade omständigheter och ser möjligheter i förändringar. Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.

För denna tjänst behöver du uppvisa ett giltigt utdrag ur belastningsregistret innan anställningsavtal kan upprättas. Beställning av ett sådant kan göras på www.polisen.se.

Välkommen med din ansökan senaste den 11 oktober. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Arbetsprov kan komma att genomföras vid intervjutillfället.

Löneform: Månadslön.
Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet:, tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse. Provanställning kan komma att tillämpas. .

Vill du vara med och göra Sveriges bästa kommun ännu bättre? Danderyds kommun erbjuder gemenskap, utveckling och delaktighet på jobbet. Vi gör skillnad och skapar värde i vardagen i dialog med alla som lever, bor och verkar här. Genom närhet och korta beslutsvägar får du möjlighet att ta ansvar och jobba med både delar och helhet i ditt yrke. Här växer vi tillsammans med engagerade invånare, företag och kompetenta kollegor i trädgårdsstadens vackra miljö. Ta steget till ett utvecklande och hållbart arbetsliv i en lagom stor kommun nära allt.

Besök gärna https://www.danderyd.se/ovriga-verksamheter/jobba/ för att ta del av mer information om kommunens uppdrag och utvecklingen framåt. Där hittar du också information om bland annat våra förmåner och vår rekryteringsprocess.

För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen i Danderyds kommun samt möjliggöra god kommunikation med våra sökande önskar vi att du skickar in din ansökan digitalt enligt ovan.

Utbildningsbevis/intyg och övriga handlingar tar du med vid en eventuell intervju.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

jobs.title: Socialsekreterare till Barnahus
jobs.description:
Stockholm – vår huvudstad med miljoner drömmar, förväntningar och ambitioner. Vi jobbar för alla som lever här idag och i framtiden. Nu söker vi dig som vill tänka stort, nytt och annorlunda med oss – för stockholmarna.

Socialförvaltningen i Stockholms stad har en övergripande och samordnande roll för socialtjänstens individ och familjeomsorg och funktionshinderområdet. Här skapas goda förutsättningar för att möta invånare i behov av socialtjänstens stöd. I nära samarbete med stadsdelsförvaltningarna bidrar vi till en modern, digital, rättssäker, likställd och kunskapsbaserad socialtjänst och vi har ett starkt utvecklingsfokus. Inom förvaltningen erbjuds ett stort utbud av stödinsatser till stadens invånare och utbudet förändras utifrån stockholmarnas behov och stadsdelsförvaltningarnas önskemål. Arbetet sker ofta i nära samverkan med andra myndigheter, civilsamhälle och näringsliv. Socialförvaltningen ansvarar också för stadens serverings- och tobakstillstånd och utför tillsyn.

Välkommen till oss

Välkommen till oss på Barnahus!

Här får du möjligheten att arbeta i en tvärprofessionell verksamhet med fokus på samverkan och barnets bästa! Vi söker dig som vill ansluta till vårt samordnarteam, och arbeta som socialsekreterare/ samordnare. Teamet leder samråd och är konsultativa mot andra professionella som är i kontakt med Barnahus.

Barnahus är en samverkansmodell mellan socialtjänst, polis, åklagare, barn och ungdomspsykiatrin samt barnmedicin. Det övergripande syftet med verksamheten är att barn, utsatta för brott i form av våld eller övergrepp ska få ett så professionellt och sammanhållet stöd och bemötande som möjligt, både i den psykosociala och i den rättsliga processen. Där har du som samordnare en viktig roll. Barnahus Stockholm ligger på Södermalm med utsikt över Söder Mälarstrand. Socialtjänsten på Barnahus tillhör området för stöd och skydd inom socialförvaltningen, Stockholm stad. Området består av verksamheter som erbjuder stöd och skydd till barn och vuxna som lever i våldsutsatthet. Här arbetar idag 5st samordnare, 3st kuratorer och 4st krisstödjare, 1st admin och 1st gruppledare samt 1st enhetschef.

Vi erbjuder

Vi erbjuder dig kompetensutveckling via utbildningar och extern handledning. Handledningen inträffar ett tillfälle var tredje vecka och är löpande terminvis. Vi erbjuder pension, företagshälsovård och friskvårdsbidrag. Vi har även tillgång till ett gym och bastu i våra lokaler. Arbetet förekommer måndag till fredag enligt flexavtal.

Din roll

Som socialsekreterare på Barnahus arbetar du med samordning av myndighetsinsatser för barn utsatt för brott i nära relation. Tjänsten innebär främst samordning mellan myndigheter och hålla i samråd med fokus på vad som blir bäst för barnet. Arbetet innebär även att vara ett stöd i frågor om våld till våra samverkande parter, kunna hålla i utbildningstillfällen och eventuellt presentera och representera Barnahus lokalt och regionalt. Ditt arbete utgår från den lagstiftning och det kunskapsstöd som finns inom området och du arbetar utifrån en evidensbaserad praktik. I ditt arbete kommer du att samarbeta både med kollegor i staden och externa samarbetspartners. I arbetet på Barnahus ingår att nära samverka med de andra myndigheterna som finns inom Barnahus så som polis, åklagare, BUP och barnmedicin. Det är av yttersta vikt att kunna samverka och bidra till ett gott samverkansklimat. Vi söker dig som trivs med ett omväxlande arbete i en föränderlig miljö där den ena dagen inte är den andra lik!

Tjänsten är tillfällig och tillsätts så fort som möjligt och pågår som längst fram till juni 2027. Det finns chans till förlängning.

Din kompetens och erfarenhet

Kvalifikationer

För denna tjänst krävs att du har:

• socionomexamen

• minst 3 års erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning Barn och unga

• god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift

• säkerhetsprövning klass 3 (vilket vi omber polisen att utreda om du blir vald för tjänsten)

Det är meriterande om du har:

• erfarenhet av att arbeta med våld och övergrepp med fokus på barn och unga, kunskap om våld och övergrepp.

• erfarenhet av nätverksarbete och att samordna mellan myndigheter.

• erfarenhet av samtal med personer i kris, kunskap om krisstöd.

Vid rekryteringen lägger vi stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och följande kompetenser:

På ett ansvarsfullt och självgående sätt tar du ansvar över dina uppgifter och driver dessa framåt. Du arbetar strukturerat och ser till att planera, organisera och prioritera arbetet på ett effektivt sätt. För att lyckas i rollen är det viktigt att du är en kommunikativ och lyhörd person som både uppskattar och har förmåga att samverka och samarbeta med andra professioner. Du har förmåga att växla mellan olika arbetsuppgifter samt kan snabbt anpassa såväl din arbetsdag som ditt arbetssätt efter ändrade omständigheter. Eftersom arbetet innebär att möta människor i kris och/eller med en komplex livssituation är det väldigt viktigt att du själv är stabil, förmedlar hopp och bemöter människor på ett respektfullt sätt.

Vi kommer intervjua löpande under ansökningstiden.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Stockholms stad arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering som syftar till att se till varje persons kompetens och därmed motverka diskriminering.

Tänk på att aldrig ladda upp registerutdrag från Polisen (Dataskyddsförordningen, GDPR) i samband med din ansökan.

Från och med 1 september 2026 ska du inte längre bifoga ett personligt brev när du söker jobb hos oss.

jobs.title: Research Assistant – CAMELOT: Long-term Climate Governance
jobs.description:
Research Assistant – CAMELOT: Long-term Climate Governance

A 50% Research Assistant position for six months is available in the ERC-funded research project CAMELOT – Capacities for More Effective Long-term Climate Governance, based at Oslo Business School, Oslo Metropolitan University (OsloMet).The research assistant will be based in the academic unit Public Administration and Governance at Oslo Business School.


About CAMELOT

Many of today's most consequential governance challenges, including climate change and Earth system risks, unfold over decades, centuries, or longer. Yet political institutions and decision-making processes often struggle to engage effectively with such long-term futures.

CAMELOT investigates the capacities that enable individuals, groups, and institutions to think about and govern for the long term. The project develops new theory on long-term governance capacities and studies how such capacities can be strengthened through experimental and participatory research. It brings together insights from political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, futures studies, psychology, and related fields.

CAMELOT is a five-year research project funded by a European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator Grant and led by associate professor Manjana Milkoreit at OsloMet.


About the position

The Research Assistant will support research within CAMELOT, particularly theoretical and conceptual work on long-term governance capacities (WP1) and the development of experimental research on long-term climate governance (WP2).

Key tasks will include:

  • identifying, collecting, organizing, and synthesizing relevant academic literature across several fields
  • conducting targeted background research and preparing research summaries and short research memos to support the development of academic publications
  • supporting manuscript preparation, including reference management, citation checking, formatting, and preparation of supplementary materials
  • supporting the development of experimental treatments through literature reviews, background research, and preparation of research and design meetings
  • researching potential partners, research sites, and other resources relevant to the development and implementation of CAMELOT's experimental work

Qualification requirements

Applicants should have:

  • a Master's degree, or be close to completing a master's degree, in political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, environmental social science, or another field relevant to CAMELOT
  • strong skills in finding, evaluating, and synthesizing academic literature
  • strong analytical and academic writing skills
  • excellent written and spoken English
  • the ability to work carefully, independently, and systematically while contributing to a collaborative research environment

It is an advantage, but not a requirement, to have experience or demonstrated interest in one or more areas relevant to CAMELOT, such as climate or environmental governance, anticipatory governance, futures studies, political psychology, or experimental social science. Experience with reference-management software and other tools for organizing and synthesizing research literature is also an advantage.

We are looking for an intellectually curious and reliable colleague who is comfortable engaging with research across disciplinary boundaries and learning new areas of scholarship.


Professional development

The position offers an opportunity to gain hands-on experience with the development of an ambitious international research project and to work closely with the Principal Investigator and other members of the CAMELOT research team. The Research Assistant will gain experience in advanced literature research and synthesis, conceptual and theoretical research, academic publishing, and the development of experimental social science research.

The position provides exposure to different stages of the research process, from developing ideas and reviewing evidence to designing studies and preparing publications. It may be particularly valuable for someone considering a PhD or another research-oriented career and seeking to strengthen their academic research skills, substantive expertise, and experience of collaborative research.

It is important to OsloMet to reflect the population of our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavors to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to make adaptations to the workplace where required. You are also welcome to apply for a position with us if you have had periods where you have not been in employment, education or training.


We offer
  • exciting job tasks at Norway’s third largest university
  • participation in research groups and a creative and inspiring academic community 
  • opportunities for academic development 
  • a workplace in the center of Oslo 
  • good welfare schemes and a wide range of sports and cultural offers 

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMets pay policy for Research Assistant in code 1020, corresponding to 527 000 NOK per year in a 100 % position. A higher salary may be considered for particularly well-qualified applicants. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK). 

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process 

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.

Please upload the following documents together by the application deadline: 

  • a one-page letter explaining your interest in the position and how your background and skills would enable you to contribute to CAMELOT
  • CV
  • certificates and transcripts 
  • one academic writing sample in English (maximum 15 pages). This may be an excerpt from a master's thesis, seminar paper, published or unpublished manuscript, or another piece of academic work that demonstrates your analytical and writing skills.

We only consider applications submitted through our electronic recruitment system, and all documents must be uploaded for your application to be considered.

OsloMet - storbyuniversitetet er Norges tredje største universitet med 23 000 studenter og over 2600 ansatte. Vi har campus i Oslo Sentrum og på Romerike. OsloMet leverer forskning og utdanning med høy relevans for arbeidslivet, velferdsstaten og storbyregionen.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Bike Club

We're customer obsessed. We put the customer at the heart of everything we do - and we're looking for people who feel the same way.

Bike Club is changing the way families access children's bikes. Through our subscription model, we make it easy for families to get the right bike at the right time, while keeping bikes in circulation for longer.

We are a purpose-led, fast-growing business with a strong focus on customer growth, retention and building a more circular approach to children's cycling.

The Role

We are looking for a commercially driven Performance Marketing Manager to manage and improve customer acquisition across the UK and Germany.

Reporting to the Marketing Director, you will be responsible for the management of the performance marketing agency and overall delivery of our paid acquisition strategy. You will manage our agency partners, monitor channel performance and use customer and commercial data to recommend where we should invest, test and optimise. This role combines performance marketing expertise with strong commercial judgement. You will work closely with Marketing, Content, Data, Product, Finance and Commercial colleagues to improve the efficiency, quality and predictability of customer acquisition.

You will be comfortable moving between strategic planning and detailed performance analysis, challenging agency recommendations and turning data into clear actions.

Tasks

What You'll Do

- Acquisition Planning

  • Develop and deliver Bike Club's customer acquisition plans across the UK and Germany in collaboration with the Marketing Director.
  • Translate business objectives into channel plans, campaign targets and testing priorities.
  • Recommend how acquisition budgets should be allocated across markets, channels and campaigns.
  • Identify new opportunities to grow customer acquisition and market penetration.
  • Develop a clear test-and-learn roadmap across channels, audiences, propositions, creative, and landing pages.
  • Continuously assess the effectiveness and scalability of acquisition channels**.**

- Performance Marketing

  • Manage our performance marketing agency and other acquisition partners ensuring they deliver against agreed objectives.
  • Oversee the day-to-day performance and optimisation of paid acquisition activity across relevant channels.
  • Lead the restructure of paid search around parent needs and intent (sizing, outgrown bikes, exchange) rather than subscription terms.
  • Review campaign plans, media spend, targeting, creative and results, constructively challenging agency recommendations where appropriate.
  • Track customer acquisition cost, conversion, return on advertising spend and other key measures of performance.
  • Focus acquisition activity on acquiring high-quality, sustainable customers rather than simply driving volume.
  • Work closely with the content team to develop strong campaign propositions, briefs and creative testing plans.
  • Identify opportunities to improve landing pages and customer journeys.
  • Ensure learning from campaigns and tests is documented and applied to future activity.

- Commercial Performance & Data

  • Own day-to-day reporting on acquisition KPIs, including CAC, conversion, ROAS, payback and customer value.
  • Partner closely with Finance and Data to understand acquisition economics and profitability.
  • Analyse performance by channel, audience, campaign, proposition and market.
  • Develop robust forecasting and scenario planning for acquisition performance for the Marketing Director and wider business
  • Ensure performance data is accurate, accessible and used consistently in decision-making.
  • Present findings and recommendations clearly to both marketing specialists and wider business stakeholders.

Requirements

About You

You'll be an experienced performance marketer who combines channel knowledge with strong commercial and analytical judgement.

You'll bring:

  • Relevant experience in performance marketing, customer acquisition or growth marketing within a consumer-focused business or agency.
  • A strong understanding of paid acquisition channels and how they work together within the customer journey.
  • Experience managing performance marketing agencies or external partners.
  • A track record of improving acquisition performance while maintaining commercial discipline.
  • Strong analytical and commercial skills, with the ability to translate data into practical recommendations.
  • Experience developing and evaluating campaign tests across audiences, creative, propositions or channels.
  • Experience managing a multi-channel, multi-market budget of £1m+, including making investment recommendations
  • A test-and-learn mindset and genuine curiosity about what drives customer behaviour.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Experience working across multiple markets, ideally including Germany is desirable.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12 months, you will have:

  • Delivered the acquisition plan in the UK and Germany hitting targets and establishing ways of working for future growth.
  • Improved the efficiency and predictability of customer acquisition.
  • Established clear acquisition KPIs and reporting.
  • Built an effective and accountable relationship with our performance marketing agency.
  • Developed a structured programme of testing across channels, audiences, propositions and creative.
  • Identified and scaled the strongest acquisition opportunities.
  • Improved collaboration between Marketing, Data, Product, Finance and Commercial teams.

Benefits

🌴We offer 26 days per year + bank holidays

💷Pension salary sacrifice

🏡Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave

🚴Employee Discount on our bikes

Why BikeClub?

You'll be joining a business with a clear purpose, a genuinely different proposition and significant opportunity to grow.

This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on the next stage of Bike Club's growth, while helping build a more sustainable way for families to access children's bikes.

jobs.title: Project Manager Internal & External Logistics
jobs.description:
Join us in shaping the future of logistics at Nobia Park!

At Nobia Park, we're building one of Europe's most modern manufacturing environments. Our new factory combines advanced automation, digitalization, and lean operations to create a highly efficient and future-focused production setup.

We are now looking for a Project Manager Internal & External Logistics to play a key role in developing and optimizing logistics processes across our manufacturing and supply chain operations. This is a unique opportunity to join a large-scale transformation journey where technology, processes, and people come together to create the factory of the future.

Where we are right now

Nobia Park is continuing its journey toward becoming a highly integrated and digitally enabled manufacturing environment. As operations evolve and new capabilities are introduced, logistics plays a critical role in ensuring efficient material flow from inbound deliveries through production to outbound distribution.

In this role, you will help develop and optimize internal logistics operations, including warehousing and picking, as well as external logistics processes such as consolidation and distribution. Working closely with operations, supply chain, and IT, you will contribute to both continuous improvements and long-term development initiatives.

About the role

As Project Manager Internal & External Logistics, you will drive logistics-related projects and process development within our MES (2020 insight) and on occasions SAP/4HANA. Acting as the link between business operations and system development, you will ensure that business needs are translated into efficient and scalable logistics solutions.

The role combines project management, process development, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement in a dynamic manufacturing environment.

Your responsibilities

    

Translate business needs into effective solutions within MES and SAP systems.

    

Work closely with production teams to develop and implement efficient logistics flows.

    

Lead and participate in cross-functional workshops to improve processes and ways of working.

    

Provide second- and third-line support, working closely with support teams to troubleshoot issues and drive resolution.

    

Drive change initiatives and help ensure new processes are successfully adopted across the organization.

    

Contribute to the development of future system and process landscapes within logistics and supply chain

    

Manage, coach, and support one direct report, ensuring clear priorities, development, and engagement.

Location: Nobia Park, Jönköping, this is an onsite position

Who you are

To succeed in this role, you are a structured and collaborative professional who enjoys working at the intersection of business processes, technology, and operations. You are comfortable navigating complex stakeholder environments and can balance strategic thinking, project delivery, and day-to-day operational support.

You enjoy solving problems, making improvements, and creating solutions that have a real impact on business performance. You build strong relationships and communicate effectively with stakeholders across different functions and levels of the organization. Most importantly, you are motivated by being part of a transformation journey where you can influence the future design and development of logistics processes.

We believe you bring

    

At least two years' experience within Logistics, Supply Chain, or Manufacturing environments.

    

Understanding of logistics processes such as warehousing, material flow, picking, transportation, and distribution

    

Experience with process design, system configuration, or solution development within manufacturing or supply chain environments.

    

Experience working with SAP S/4HANA, preferably within Transport Management (TM), Warehouse Logistics, or related manufacturing systems.

    

Experience leading projects, process improvements, or business development initiatives

    

The ability to bridge business requirements and technical solutions

    

Experience leading teams or coordinating cross-functional initiatives.

    

Fluent in both Swedish and English.

It is highly desirable if you have experience with Azure DevOps

About Nobia

Nobia is Europe’s leading kitchen specialist, with strong brands such as Marbodal, HTH, Sigdal, and uno form. With us, you will become part of a modern organization where quality, safety, and continuous improvement are at the core of everything we do. We offer excellent opportunities for both professional and personal development. Curious to learn more? Visit Nobia Park – Jönköping. 

Want to be a part of our journey?

Then we would like to receive your application in English no later than October 18, 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. Our recruitment process is competency-based and includes assessments to provide both you and us with the best possible conditions for a successful match. As part of the employment process, you will need to demonstrate your right to work within the EU, for example through a passport or a valid work permit. Background checks and drug screening will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.

If you have any questions, please contact Talent Acquisition Specialist Josephine Tjernlund (josephine.tjernlund@nobia.com). We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
About Univrses

Univrses is a Stockholm-based 3D Computer Vision and AI company. We provide the perception and spatial awareness necessary for an increasingly autonomous world. While our roots are in the automotive sector, we have pioneered a new category: Infrastructure Intelligence. Our 3DAI™ system transforms ordinary vehicles into sophisticated mobile sensors, providing road authorities across Europe (Sweden, UK, Italy, and beyond) with real-time, actionable insights. We are shifting city management from reactive repairs to proactive, data-driven maintenance—saving costs, reducing CO2 emissions, and improving public safety.

The Role

In your new developer role, you will take part in building the 3DAI™ platform. It is a scalable answer to the growing demand for data about the urban environment and part of our efforts in smart city development. You will play an important role in designing, building and scaling the platform. 3DAI™ is still a young product and you will have a lot to contribute and freedom to shape the project.

    

You will be responsible for growing our platform for storing, processing and visualizing data.

    

You will use your experience to design efficient solutions for our backend and frontend systems.

    

You will have the opportunity to create innovative technologies that will change people's lives and transform the world into a better place

Who you are

    

You have at least 3+ years of experience in Fullstack software development using Node.js and Typescript on the backend, and React (Vite SPA) on the frontend.

    

You are experienced with AWS cloud platform development.

    

You have excellent general understanding of REST APIs and GraphQL.

    

You are comfortable taking high-level front-end designs and turning that into readable, maintainable, best-practice React code.

    

You can build web-services from high level specifications, including figuring out database schemas, security considerations, logging and monitoring, and how best to scale out deployments to handle lots of users and data.

    

You have an enthusiasm to tackle large-scale data challenges, with prior experience on high-performance analytic databases as a bonus.

    

You like working in a team and sharing your knowledge. You are open to giving advice and listening to feedback.

    

You are passionate about writing high-quality code and care for ensuring code validity by writing unit and integration tests.

    

You keep up-to-date with best practices and new technologies.

    

You have an aspiration to see your ideas move into production.

Bonus points

You have experience working with any of these systems or technologies:

    

Serverless computing (e.g. AWS Lambdas)

    

Familiar to infrastructure as code technologies such as Docker, AWS Cloudformation/CDK

    

Geo spatial tools and databases such as PostGIS

    

MUI (Material-UI) based front-end components

    

E2E testing frameworks like Playwright

What’s in it for You?

We provide the environment and the tools for you to do the best work of your career.

    

Responsibility: Become a true stakeholder in a small team where your work actually matters.

    

Professional Evolution: You will be working on exciting projects involving game-changing technology with an opportunity to improve the world through autonomy and intelligence

    

The "Work-Life" Blend: Enjoy flexible work hours and a culture that values output over "desk time".

    

Upsides: A secure Pension Plan and Wellness activities for up to 5 000 SEK per year paid by the company.

    

The Univrses Culture:

    

Monday Momentum: Kick off the week with team breakfast.

    

Thursday Knowledge: Weekly Lunch & Learns where internal or external speakers present interesting topics, while the company pays for and caters the lunch to keep your technical and commercial skills sharp.

    

Friday Wind-down: Celebrate the week’s wins with our Friday After Work sessions (free beer from our well-curated beer fridge!)

    

The Workspace: A bright, collaborative office in Stockholm equipped with the essentials (yes, including the mandatory startup ping-pong table).

Are You Our Next Full Stack Engineer?

If you are a driven, creative strategist ready to shape the future of autonomous systems, we want to hear from you.

To apply, please include the following:

    

Your CV

    

A link to your LinkedIn profile

    

A brief introduction (tell us about a time you turned a challenging customer situation into a success).

Note: All application materials must be in English.

jobs.title: Asumisen avustaja, Riihitien palvelukoti, Liperi
jobs.description:
**Asumisen avustaja, Riihitien palvelukoti, Liperi**

Pidätkö ruoanlaitosta, siivoamisesta ja viihtyisän ympäristön luomisesta? Haluatko tehdä työtä, jolla on merkitys ihmisten päivittäisessä elämässä?

Haemme **asumisen avustajaa Riihitien palvelukotiin Liperiin** määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen (vähintään 29.11.2026 saakka)**.**

Riihitie on koti 12 kehitysvammaiselle aikuiselle, jotka elävät jokainen omannäköistään elämää turvallisesti ja tuetusti. Asumisen avustajana olet tärkeä osa työyhteisöämme ja asukkaidemme arkea.

**Mitä työ sisältää?**

Asumisen avustajana vastaat yksikön arjen tukitoiminnoista. Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa:

- ruoan valmistamista ja muita ruokahuollon tehtäviä


- tekstiilihuoltoa, esim. pyykinpesua


- yksikön puhtaanapitoa


Asukkaat saattavat joskus tarjoutua avuksesi tehtäviisi tai tulla rupattelemaan. Sinun ei tarvitse toimia ohjaajana, mutta osallistut ohjaajien rinnalla asukkaiden viihtyisän ja turvallisen arjen mahdollistamiseen.

**Mitä toivomme sinulta?**

Toivomme, että olet oma-aloitteinen, vastuullinen ja kohtaat ihmiset arvostavasti.

Tehtävässä tarvitset:

- soveltuvan koulutuksen (esim. hoiva-avustajan tutkinto) tai aikaisemman kokemuksen kautta hankitun osaamisen tehtävään (esim. kokemus vastaavista tukitehtävistä ja/tai kehitysvamma-alalta)


- hygieniapassin ja elintarviketyötä tekevän terveydentilaselvityksen


- hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja suomen kielen taidon


- kiinnostusta työskennellä kehitysvammaisten henkilöiden kanssa.


**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- määräaikaisen työsuhteen vähintään 29.11.2026 asti sekä säännölliset arkipäiviin sijoittuvat työvuorot


- Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n mukaisen palkan (palkkaluokka G16A/G18B koulutustaustan mukaan)


- merkityksellisen työn osana asumispalveluiden arkea


- työyhteisön tuen ja perehdytyksen tehtäviisi


- mahdollisuuden hyödyntää omia vahvuuksiasi ja osaamistasi.


**Tule toteuttamaan hyvää arkea**

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään 11.10.2026 osoitteeseen rekrytointi@hl-s.fi tai käyttäen verkkosivujemme hakulomaketta (https://www.honkalampi.fi/avoin-hakemus/). Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja tehtävä täytetään pikaisesti, heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa palvelukotivastaava Kirsi Juvonen, puh. 050 388 6639.

_Tule mukaan rakentamaan kanssamme pykälää parempaa arkea. Honkalampi-säätiössä teemme työtä, jotta kenenkään unelmat eivät jäisi olosuhteiden tai tuen puutteen vuoksi toteutumatta. Meillä johtaminen tapahtuu arjessa ja ihmisten keskellä – meillä koti on koti._

_Asumispalveluidemme arkea pääset seuraamaan myös Facebookin ja Instagramin puolella. Löydät meidän tunnisteella_ @honkalampiasumispalvelut

www.honkalampi.fi

jobs.title: Skap førsteklasses matopplevelser som sushikokk hos oss
jobs.description:
Vi søker en sushikokk med lidenskap for gode råvarer, kvalitet og håndverk. Hos oss får du muligheten til å arbeide i et spennende miljø med fokus på smak, service og gjesteopplevelser.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter en kvalitetsbevisst og engasjert sushikokk med lidenskap for gode råvarer, presisjon og håndverk. Du har et øye for detaljer, jobber strukturert og trives i et hektisk kjøkkenmiljø der kvalitet og samarbeide står i fokus.

Du er opptatt av å levere retter med høy standard, tar ansvar for eget arbeid og bidrar positivt til arbeidsmiljøet. Samtidig er du kreativ og ønsker å være med på å utvikle spennende smaksopplevelser for våre gjester.

Erfaring som sushikokk er en fordel, men riktig innstilling, faglig stolthet og lyst til å utvikle seg er vel så viktig.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Tilberede sushi, sashimi og andre japanskinspirerte retter etter høye kvalitetsstandarder

  • Sikre riktig håndtering, oppbevaring og kontroll av råvarer

  • Bidra til utvikling av menyer, nye retter og sesongbaserte konsepter

  • Sørge for at kjøkkenet til enhver tid følger gjeldende rutiner for hygiene, IK-mat og matsikkerhet

  • Bestilling, mottak og kontroll av varer

  • Bidra til effektiv drift og god flyt på kjøkkenet

  • Samarbeide tett med øvrige kokker, servitører og restaurantledelse

  • Sikre høy kvalitet og presentasjon på alle retter som serveres

  • Bidra til å redusere svinn og sikre god råvareutnyttelse

  • Delta i daglig renhold og vedlikehold av kjøkken og utstyr

Vi tilbyr

Spennende utfordringer i et selskap med høyt tempo og godt miljø.

Personalfordeler i Fredensborg Hospitality.

Konkurransedyktige betingelser.

Stillingsprosent etter avtale.

Lønn etter tariff.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kragerø Resort er et av Norges ledende resortanlegg, med hotell, restaurant, spa, konferansefasiliteter og golfbane i vakre omgivelser ved kysten. Vi er opptatt av å skape minnerike opplevelser gjennom personlig service, høy kvalitet og ekte gjesteglede.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Associate
jobs.description:
Job Scope

Why does the role exist? High level purpose of function.

The Manufacturing Associate performs all functions associated with manufacturing operations. This includes operating process machines and auxiliary equipment, troubleshooting, and maintaining the machine. The manufacturing associate is also expected to collaborate with colleagues and engineers on tasks including (but not restricted to): set-up, calibration, rework, material handling, sampling and experiments. This role requires technical understanding of the manufacturing process and uses custom programs to support the collection of operating data to make real-time adjustments to processes, instruments or equipment. The manufacturing associate will assist in developing methods and procedures to control or modify the manufacturing process and improve shop floor management.  

Key Responsibilities

Overall areas of responsibilities and activities

Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)

    Assure safe conditions through defined procedures (including Lock out tag out – LOTO) during equipment repairs, cleaning, or inspections.

    Work under the defined shift model to ensure customer demand is met in the assigned production time. Working full-time on the shop floor, supporting operation. 

    Operate the process machines and material handling equipment used in production, following implemented work instructions, standard operating procedures, and guidelines.

    Perform troubleshooting, autonomous maintenance, cleaning activities and pre-start up inspections/safety checks on production and material handling equipment and fixtures.

    Support the review and optimization of work instructions and process documentation.

    Train and validate the competence of new manufacturing associates.

    Assist with the distribution and handling/re-stocking of PPE and shop floor consumables.

    Handle production waste.

    Report current condition, status and also deviations in machine function, area cleanliness or personnel behavior to shift leader.

    Contribute to maintaining high 5S standards within the process areas and general factory areas.

    Follow all currently implemented work instructions and standard operating procedures for cleaning, material handling, waste handling, and PPE use.

    Maintain accurate records and documentation related to the machine, product, and process.

    Work proactively with the support functions (Manufacturing technicians, quality, logistics, etc).

    Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resources for the benefit of the business.

Requirements

Educational background and previous experience required for the role

Qualifications and Experience

    High school education or a relevant education (e.g., industrial program at a gymnasium level, automation operator/technician education, process operator/technician education) is a plus.

    1 year previous experience from the manufacturing or processing industry (e.g., battery, pulp and paper, food, chemicals, microelectronics, oil & gas, pharmaceutical processing).

    Experience with some of the following is advantageous: permit procedures, Lock Out Tag Out, near-miss reporting, safety audits, maintenance audits, process control systems, and daily follow-up on safety actions.

    Understanding how to utilize equipment to run efficient manufacturing with energy and costing optimization.
    Experience with production processes including mechanical, electrical, pneumatic and hydraulic components.

Specific skills & Knowledge  

    Knowledge of Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) or other sample tracking software is a plus.

    Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams.

    High work ethic, critical thinking, and strong problem-solving skills are a must.  

    This role requires the ability to stand for extended periods and perform manual labor in physically demanding environments. This can include 100% working hours allocation into clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. The role also requires working shifts and working in multiple process areas, according to business needs. This role requires working full-time on the shop floor, supporting operation. 

    A genuine technical interest and curiosity about working within production is highly valued. A good understanding of machines and equipment such as pipes, pumps, and valves is a plus.
